jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Avèro Advisors**  
  
Avèro Advisors is a fast-growing boutique management consulting firm that modernizes technology and business operations for state and local governments. We guide public-sector clients through high-stakes transformation initiatives spanning ERP modernization, permitting & licensing, budgeting, HR, data, and AI adoption. Our marquee clients include the Port of Portland (OR), Monroe County (NY), Santa Fe County (NM), Clackamas County (OR), Tarrant County (TX), and other forward-thinking governments across the United States.

Recognized for our exceptional momentum, Avèro has earned a place on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years, reflecting our continued growth and commitment to excellence.

**How We Work**

  

* Service-centric, not SaaS: We don’t sell software; we deliver expertise, clarity, and outcomes.
* AI-accelerated: Our proprietary Vision & Velocity™ delivery framework embeds generative-AI accelerators, reusable automations, and data-driven insights into every phase of an engagement.
* Runs on EOS®: Traction tools, quarterly Rocks, Scorecards, and Level-10 meetings ensure transparency, accountability, and consistent execution across the firm.

**Our Ethos**

Avèro stands as a beacon of innovation, driven by the purpose of making government interactions simpler through technology. We focus on enabling agencies to implement efficient, automated enterprise systems that improve service delivery and enhance the lives of citizens.

As a minority-owned, MBE/DBE-certified firm, we are deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and expanding opportunity—within our company and the communities we serve.  
  
**What We Offer:**

* High Growth Opportunity: Avèro Advisors is on a remarkable growth trajectory. The right candidates will have the chance to move up quickly, taking on more significant responsibilities and shaping the future of the company.
* Impactful Work: Make a real difference in how local governments serve their communities, improving the lives of citizens through technology.
* Inclusive Culture: Join a team that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. We believe in giving every idea a chance to shine and every team member the opportunity to grow.

**Join Us:**

At Avèro Advisors, we’re not just consultants—we’re change-makers. If you're driven to make a lasting impact and ready to accelerate your career in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you. Together, we can redefine what’s possible for local governments and the communities they serve.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support our ERP implementation team. This role provides administrative, coordination, and project support services to the ERP Program Manager, PMO, and project workstream leads. The Project Coordinator is responsible for maintaining project documentation, coordinating meetings, tracking action items, supporting governance processes, and ensuring project information is organized, accurate, and accessible.

The ideal candidate is proactive, collaborative, and thrives in a fast-paced project environment. This role plays a critical part in supporting day-to-day project operations and helping ensure ERP implementation activities remain aligned with established governance, reporting, and project management standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Project Coordination & Administration:** Provide administrative support to the ERP Program Manager, PMO, and project leadership team. Coordinate project meetings, workshops, Steering Committee sessions, and governance forums. Develop and distribute meeting agendas, materials, minutes, and follow-up communications. Maintain project calendars, milestone schedules, and meeting cadence across multiple workstreams. Track action items and follow up with responsible parties to ensure timely completion. Manage and oversee agentic AI tools that automate routine project tasks, such as meeting notes, action-item tracking, status report drafts, and log updates. Review their outputs for accuracy and escalate anything that needs human judgment.
* **Documentation Management:** Maintain project repositories, document libraries, and collaboration sites. Ensure project documents are properly version-controlled, organized, and archived. Manage project plans, status reports, presentations, decisions, governance records, and supporting documentation. Assist in preparing executive reports and presentation materials.
* **Governance & Reporting Support:** Support project governance processes and meeting logistics. Assist in preparing weekly, monthly, and executive-level status reports. Maintain key project logs, including Action Item Logs, Decision Logs, RAID Logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies), and Change Request Logs. Support stage-gate reviews, readiness assessments, and governance reporting activities.
* **Resource & Schedule Coordination:** Coordinate project schedules and resource activities across multiple workstreams. Support onboarding activities for project team members, consultants, and vendors. Monitor attendance and participation in project meetings and workshops. Facilitate coordination between business teams, technical teams, consultants, and third-party vendors.
* **Financial & Procurement Support:** Assist with invoice tracking, vendor documentation, and procurement activities. Maintain project budget records and expenditure documentation. Support contract administration and purchase request processes.
* **Communication & Change Support:** Assist with project communications, stakeholder updates, and distribution of project announcements. Support change management activities, training logistics, and stakeholder engagement efforts. Maintain project contact lists and communication distribution groups.

jobs.title: Wound Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Sunnyside Nursing Post-Acute Care**

Centrally located in Torrance, California, Sunnyside Nursing and Post-Acute Care provides sub-acute nursing care, rehabilitation services, skilled nursing, and long-term care. Our compassionate staff offers individualized care plans for each resident to ensure personalized care is provided to all our patients with a goal to return home.

Our team of qualified professionals provides compassionate care by:

* Maintaining high medical integrity
* Fostering a team spirit among staff
* Creating friendly, beautiful surroundings for our residents and their visitors

We understand the importance of creating a comfortable and nurturing atmosphere, whether residents stay for short-term treatment or long-term care.

**Job Description**

The **Wound Program Coordinator** manages the facility wound care program including standards of care and practice related to wound, ostomy, and continence patient care needs.

Essential Functions:

* Develops and implements the facility wound care program in conjunction with the national standardization process, to include patient care protocols, documentation tools, and wound care formulary.
* Establishes standards of care, competencies, policies and procedures in quality, cost efficient and effective wound care for all clinical staff.
* Evaluates all wounds upon admission and ongoing to determine treatment plan and provide early problem identification.
* Provides consultation and/or assessment on patients with pressure ulcers. Consults on any wound that does not show measurable signs of healing within two weeks.
* In consultation with the physician, assists staff in developing an appropriate plan of care for comprehensive wound management.
* Makes recommendations to the physician for changes to wound care orders and provides evidence based research support as needed.
* Reviews charts of patients with wounds. Ensures that wound assessments, care plans, and treatments are clearly and correctly documented and that appropriate wound related treatments are being provided. Investigates all cases with adverse events related to wounds.
* Participates in clinical outcome monitoring, follow-up and agency performance improvement initiatives.
* Serves as a consultant to facility staff through training and support, enables clinical staff to effectively assess wounds, recommend appropriate protocols, and initiate plans of care.
* Manages Wound Treatment Team to ensure there is adequate coverage and employees are performing tasks based on expected standard
* Collaborates with Central Supply staff to maintain a cost-effective wound care formulary.
* Evaluates products and cost effectiveness and makes recommendation.
* Reviews and develops with all involved disciplines plan for discharge.
* Evaluates culture results and conference with physicians on Plan of Care.
* Involved in marketing the wound care program through outcomes and relationships with physicians.

**Licenses/Certification:**

* Current state LVN or RN license.
* Professional certification WOCN or CWS, or obtain certification within 12 months of employment.

**Experience:**

* Five (5) years licensed professional nursing experience performing wound care in a SNF, acute, or subacute setting.

  
**Requirements**

Must have a current and active California LVN or RN License

Must be authorized to work in the United States

Full-Time

Monday - Friday

8:30am - 5:00pm

My be required to work some weekends

  
  
**Benefits**

**Why Work for Sunnyside Nursing & Post-Acute Care**

* Annual salary of $99,840 - $114,400
* Paid orientation and training
* Opportunities for growth
* Paid sick leave/paid holidays
* Medical, dental, vision, and Supplemental Insurance
* 401K
* Loving and caring work environment

We take great pride in meeting or exceeding CDC and CMS standards. On-site experts provide teaching, coaching, and support on infection prevention practices. In addition, we maintain an abundant supply of PPE, including N95/KN95 masks, for all who provide care and services to our patients and residents. Our multiple testing capabilities, including Point-of-Care (POC) testing, are available at every location and comply with CMS and local guidance

If hired, we require that all employees be vaccinated, unless a medical or religious accommodation is needed.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity & pride ourselves on creating an inclusive environment for all employees and residents.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  
  
Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for an Events and Field Marketing Manager to own Sift’s events program, with a primary focus on events that build pipeline. You’ll run Sift’s presence at industry trade shows and conferences, host customer dinners and roundtables, and build community events that bring the hardware engineering community to Sift. You’ll also partner with Talent and Operations on recruiting events. This is a hands-on role with real ownership of a calendar, a budget, and a pipeline target. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and leadership to reach engineers and technical leaders across aerospace, defense, autonomy, and other hardware industries.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own Sift’s annual event calendar and budget, including trade shows, conferences, sponsorships, and speaking submissions, and measure the return on each.
* Plan and run Sift’s presence at industry events end to end, from booth logistics, vendors, and staffing to lead capture and follow-up within 48 hours, using repeatable runbooks and reusable assets.
* Build Sift’s owned event program, including customer dinners, technical roundtables, and a recurring community series in San Francisco and Los Angeles, and capture content from each event to share across Sift’s channels.
* Partner with Sales and RevOps to build target account invite lists, book meetings before each event, and track event-sourced and influenced pipeline so we invest more in what works and cut what doesn’t.
* Partner with Talent and Operations on recruiting events that build candidate pipeline and support Sift’s hiring goals.

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 5+ years of experience in field or event marketing at a B2B technology company, with direct ownership of an event calendar, a budget, and a pipeline goal.
* A track record of running trade show booths, executive dinners, and community events end to end, for audiences ranging from executives to engineers.
* Experience partnering with sales teams to turn event engagement into qualified meetings and pipeline, and reporting on results using CRM and marketing automation tools.
* Strong operational discipline and the ability to manage multiple events at once with minimal direction, from contracts and shipping deadlines to vendor invoices.
* Ability to learn a technical product quickly and represent it credibly to engineers and technical leaders.

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience as the first or only field marketer at an early-stage startup, building the program from scratch.
* Experience marketing to engineering audiences in aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, automotive, or energy, including relationships with the major events in these sectors.
* Experience marketing in NDA-constrained environments, where customers often cannot be named publicly.
* Experience running partner and co-marketing programs, including shared booths and co-hosted events.
* Experience running recruiting events or partnering closely with a talent team.

**Location:**
-------------

Sift’s headquarters is in **Marina Del Rey, CA** (Next to LAX). We collaborate **in person** twice a week—on **Mondays and Thursdays**—and come together for a full week once every quarter. We are open to **relocating candidates to LA** or **working from our San Francisco** office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $125,000 - $175,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident (Green Card Holder), or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

Compensation Range: $125K - $175K

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Events Coordinator is responsible for planning, organizing, and executing the day-to-day logistics of events, including meetings, budget management, promotional activations, creative development, food and beverage, entertainment, travel arrangements, and internal documentation and processes. This role ensures all event-related activities are seamlessly coordinated, delivered on schedule, and aligned with established budgets.  
  
Working closely with talent, filmmakers, event agencies, internal teams, and third-party vendors, the Events Coordinator oversees event timelines, materials, venue logistics, and on-site operations from initial planning through execution. In partnership with the Senior Events Lead, this role provides essential support throughout the campaign, helping drive coordination across all work streams, maintain operational efficiency, and ensure every aspect of the event process is executed smoothly and successfully.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Event Planning & Timeline Management: Develop and maintain event schedules, task lists, and detailed run-of-show documents. Assist with venue sourcing and bookings, permit coordination, and the preparation of event-related documentation.  
  
Vendor & Staffing Coordination: Identify, source, book, and manage communications with event vendors, including catering, audiovisual, décor, entertainment, and security providers.
  
  
Coordinate event staff, contractors, and volunteers to ensure all operational needs are met.  
  
Budget & Resource Management: Monitor event budgets, track expenses, process invoices and purchase orders, and help ensure spending remains within approved parameters. Coordinate the procurement and delivery of event supplies, signage, and promotional materials.  
  
On-Site Event Execution: Support and oversee event setup, registration and guest check-in, attendee assistance, vendor coordination, and adherence to event schedules. Proactively address logistical challenges and troubleshoot issues in real time to ensure a seamless event experience.  
  
Post-Event Operations & Reporting: Coordinate post event activity, manage attendance and RSVP reporting, reconcile expenses, and gather post-event feedback to support reporting and identify opportunities for improvement.

We are a dynamic, fast-paced events team managing a high volume of projects, priorities, and deadlines. Our success relies on strong collaboration, clear communication, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional work. As a team, we thrive in a fast-moving environment where adaptability, teamwork, and a willingness to go above and beyond are essential.

* 1+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience

* Demonstrated attention to detail
* Excellent judgment, particularly in narrow timeframes
* Experience working on events for studios, brands, or agencies in the entertainment industry

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Pet Specialty

**Key Account Manager – Pet**

**Reports to:** Sr. Sales Manager  
**Category Focus:** Pet Specialty  
**Pay:** $90K-105K / year

Inaba Foods is a manufacturer of premium pet food, treats, toppers, and complements, deeply rooted in a family tradition of excellence that spans generations. Since 1958, pet parents have trusted Inaba to deliver products that are human-grade, nutrient-rich, and designed to bring joy to pets.  
  
Today, Inaba is the most popular brand of premium cat and dog dinners and treats in Japan, with growing distribution throughout the United States and globally. Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. continues to expand its footprint, invest in talent, and build long-term partnerships across the pet industry, supported by the stability and vision of our Japanese parent company.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. is seeking a Key Account Manager – Pet to develop and manage strategic relationships at the headquarters and regional level with national and regional retailers, as well as distributors, within the Pet Specialty channel. This role is responsible for driving growth, expanding distribution, and strengthening long-term partnerships while collaborating closely with internal teams to execute sales strategies.  
  
This is a full-time, in-office position based in Torrance, CA, as required by company leadership.  
  
**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights
* Collaborate cross-functionally to support forecasting, production planning, and account strategy

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and distributors, nurturing existing business and driving incremental growth
* Analyze historical and current purchase order data to project sales, assess profitability, and identify growth opportunities
* Lead and participate in customer business reviews and market presentations
* Maintain regular engagement with accounts to ensure customer needs are met or exceeded
* Execute promotional strategies and programs to drive volume and brand visibility
* Provide sales forecasts and input for production and demand planning
* Collaborate with executive leadership on pricing, promotions, quotes, and account strategies
* Resolve customer issues related to product, service, or sales execution
* Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and merchandising techniques
* Manage expenses in alignment with budgeted guidelines
* Demonstrate a growth-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3–7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food & Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

**Professional Conduct & Collaboration**

* Professionalism & Respect: Communicate respectfully and constructively with others, even in challenging situations.

* Problem-Solving: Approach challenges proactively with a solution-oriented mindset.

**Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long-term stability and leadership from a well-established Japanese parent company
* Opportunity to manage meaningful accounts and influence growth strategy

Inaba Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws, including California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
ADC Aerospace is a Buena Park, California-based precision manufacturing company serving customers across the aerospace and defense, medical, automotive, and industrial markets. Our core capabilities include aluminum and zinc die casting, CNC machining, finishing, and integrated manufacturing solutions designed to meet the demanding requirements of our customers. We are committed to delivering high-quality products, operational excellence, and dependable manufacturing solutions while maintaining a safe, collaborative, and quality-driven work environment. At ADC Aerospace, we value individuals who demonstrate strong teamwork, a commitment to excellence, and a results-oriented mindset. We expect our employees to take ownership and accountability for their responsibilities, demonstrate initiative, embrace challenges, and continuously seek opportunities for improvement. Our people are essential to our success, and every team member plays an important role in supporting our customers, strengthening our operations, and delivering the precision, quality, and performance our industries demand.

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for managing and growing the relationships with key customers. The KAM ensures that the needs of these customers are met, creates strategies to maintain and expand business, and works closely with internal teams to deliver the best solutions. The role involves client management, business development, and contributing to the overall success and growth of the company.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Client Relationship Management:**
  + Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers.
  + Serve as the primary point of contact for the assigned key accounts.
  + Understand the customers’ business needs and work to provide customized win-win solutions that protects ADC profitability.
  + Proactively communicates both externally to customer and internal management team on material issues or opportunities. Effective communicate issue and elevate problems with appropriate solutions to mitigate issues. Have high sense of urgency to eliminate problems and complete tasks.
* **Business Development:**
  + Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling products/services. Negotiate Price increase and projects ADC profit.
  + Collaborate with the internal teams to implement strategies that will help grow the business.
  + Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the client’s industry, competitive landscape, and end-market dynamics.
* **Strategic Planning:**
  + Develop proactively and implement account strategies to achieve both client and company goals.
  + Monitor account performance, identify areas for improvement, and proactively work with the client and internal teams to resolve any issues.
  + Work with VP of sales/management to set aggressive and realistic booking targets for each key account.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  + Work proactively with internal teams (e.g., product, operations, quality, finance) to deliver seamless solutions to customers.
  + Provide feedback to product development teams on client needs and product improvement opportunities.
* **Reporting, Analytics and Streamlining Processes:**
  + Develop and report on key account metrics such as booking, revenue growth, client satisfaction, and project delivery timelines.
  + Prepare and present regular business reviews to customers and internal stakeholders.
  + Proactively analyze customer data both in booking, sales or profitability to identify issues and opportunities. Mitigate issue and seize opportunity to ensure meeting growth target.
  + Analyze key functional process for its effectiveness and efficiency. Eliminate non-valued added activities.
* **Problem Solving & Issue Resolution:**
  + Act as the main problem solver for customers’ issues, ensuring that concerns are handled quickly and effectively.
  + Manage and mitigate risks associated with key accounts with high sense of urgency.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business or Engineering with business experience or related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Experience:**
  + Proven experience as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing internal sales role. This is not a field sales role.
  + Experience in managing large accounts or high-value customers.
  + Strong understanding of sales principles, account management, and customer service.
  + Strong understanding of Engineering, operations, sales processes and relationships cross functionally in a manufacturing environment. Aerospace & Defense (A&D) experience preferred but not required.
  + Minimum 5 years in managing direct reports preferably internal key account management teams
  + Minimum 7 years in build to print manufacturing business, and experience in working with major OEM and Tier 1 A&D companies.
  + Demonstrate experience in development and execution of annual booking and sales plan/budget/forecast.
  + Expert level competency in MS Excel and MS PowerPoint.
  + Proficient in ERP system and reporting tools (ADC currently uses Syteline)
* **Skills:**
  + Strong negotiation and presentation abilities.
  + Problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  + Strong business acumen and understanding of the client’s industry.
  + High energy, self-driven, and proactive with a demonstrated ability to lead and motivate a team.
  + Strong ability to build and maintain lasting client relationships, with a keen focus on customer satisfaction.
  + Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively engage with customers, employees, and executives.
  + Demonstrated ability to organize and prioritize tasks effectively,
  + Strong analytical skills and the ability to effectively solve problems and resolve conflicts.
  + Comfortable with adopting systems and technologies that streamline business processes.
  + Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline

**What You Will Own**

**Develop New Business**  
Identify prospective customers, arrange meetings, and secure new product placements. Present food and beverage options that fit each customer’s operation, consumer preferences, and sales goals.

**Grow Existing Accounts**  
Understand what each account purchases and where there is room to expand. Introduce additional products, support relevant promotions, and follow up on results to build repeat business.

**Manage Customer Relationships**  
Stay in regular contact with operators and distributors. Understand their priorities, respond to questions, and coordinate with G & J and manufacturer partners to address issues that affect sales.

**Represent Our Manufacturer Partners**  
Know the products, pricing, and programs you represent. Give customers accurate information and work with G & J’s National Sales Managers on opportunities that need additional supplier support.

**Manage Your Territory**  
Determine your daily schedule, sales approach, priorities, and methods within the defined territory and applicable brand standards. Keep customer activity and opportunities current in the CRM, and use sales reports to guide account follow-up.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* Retain and grow the existing business within the territory
* Add customers and expand product distribution within current accounts
* Turn new placements and promotions into repeat purchases
* Maintain a current pipeline and follow through on customer commitments
* Grow territory sales and commission earnings through active account development

**Who This Role Is Ideal For**

This role is suited to an experienced salesperson who enjoys working directly with customers and wants to manage a defined territory independently.

You are comfortable asking for the business, following up after a meeting, and staying involved after the first order. You recognize opportunities within existing accounts as well as with new customers.

Experience with CPG, foodservice, vending, office coffee, or distribution is valuable. You understand how product selection, availability, and consistent service influence a customer’s buying decisions.

You can organize your work without daily direction and are comfortable with earnings tied to sales performance. You want an established customer base to develop while taking responsibility for the business you build.

**Experience and Skills**

* Proven success in sales, account management, and new business development
* Ability to grow and manage a defined sales territory independently
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and customer communication skills
* Organization and consistent follow-through across multiple accounts and opportunities
* Comfort using CRM tools, sales reports, and virtual meetings to support field sales
* Experience in CPG, foodservice, brokerage, or related channels; local industry relationships a plus

**Compensation Structure**

This is a sales performance role with commission-based compensation tied to the sales you generate and actively service. The territory includes existing business already generating commissions, with additional earning potential through new accounts, expanded distribution, and growth within current customers.

Compensation reflects sales performance, account growth, and customer retention. You determine how to organize and develop your business within the defined territory.

**Territory and Travel**

The representative should be based in Los Angeles, CA and actively cover the territory. Travel within the territory is expected for customer visits, distributor meetings, and relevant industry events.

Application Question(s):

* Do you have sales experience in one or more of the following, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Vending, Office Coffee Services (OCS)?

Experience:

* Sales: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90041

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**About us**

LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience

**About the Position**

The **Program Coordinator,** under the direction of the Regional Director of Social Services, is expected to design, implement, and coordinate activities and programs within assigned affordable housing complexes. This position works closely with the Director of Social Services (DSS) to provide the highest quality of service to the residents served by LifeSTEPS.

**Core Duties** **Program Coordinator**

You’ll run Sift’s presence at industry trade shows and conferences, host customer dinners and roundtables, and build community events that bring the hardware engineering community to Sift. jobs.description:
Event Coordinator (Part-Time / Event-Based)

**715 Harrison | City Nights — San Francisco, CA**

**Job Type:** Part-Time | Variable Hours | Event-Driven Schedule

**Pay:** $28–$35 per hour, depending on experience

**Location:** San Francisco, CA | Hybrid Administrative & On-Site Work

About Us

715 Harrison is a versatile event venue located in the heart of San Francisco's SoMa district. Home to the iconic City Nights nightclub, our space hosts a wide range of private, corporate, entertainment, and nightlife events.

From corporate conferences and brand activations to live performances, private celebrations, and large-scale productions, our events program is dynamic, fast-paced, and constantly evolving.

We're looking for a detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive **Part-Time Event Coordinator** to support the planning, coordination, and execution of events from initial booking through final breakdown.

About the Role

This is a hands-on coordination role combining administrative responsibilities, event logistics, some client communication, and on-site production support.

Working closely with our Creative Director and venue operations team, the Event Coordinator will support the moving pieces that go into producing successful events, ensuring that details are organized, deadlines are met, and events run smoothly.

**Important Scheduling Information:**

This is a part-time position with variable hours based on event volume and operational needs. Weekly hours are not guaranteed and will fluctuate depending on the number, size, and complexity of events on our calendar.

Some weeks may involve primarily remote administrative and coordination work, while others will require more extensive on-site involvement during event load-ins, setups, execution, and breakdowns.

Candidates must be comfortable with a flexible schedule that may include evenings, weekends, and occasional late nights.

Key Responsibilities

**Event Planning & Coordination**

* Assist with coordinating events from booking confirmation through execution and post-event wrap-up.
* Update event documentation, including run-of-shows, floor plans, production briefs, and internal event summaries.
* Coordinate event logistics, including equipment, furniture, rentals, deliveries, and vendor scheduling.
* Track outstanding client requirements, approvals, and production details.

**Client & Vendor Communication**

* Serve as a point of contact for assigned event coordination matters.
* Assist with client walkthroughs, planning meetings, and production calls.
* Communicate with vendors regarding quotes, deliveries, setup requirements, and logistics.
* Follow up on outstanding event details to ensure all parties are prepared ahead of event day.

**On-Site Event Production**

* Assist with event load-ins, venue setup, and production preparation.
* Coordinate with venue management, security, bartenders, technical staff, and outside vendors.
* Help oversee event setup to ensure the venue is prepared according to approved floor plans and client requirements.
* Support event execution, troubleshoot logistical issues, and help maintain event timelines.
* Assist with breakdown, vendor load-out, and venue resets as needed.

**Administrative & Operational Support**

* Maintain organized event files, schedules, and documentation.
* Assist with tracking event-related expenses, invoices, and vendor payments.
* Support internal communication between event production, operations, and management.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, organization, and overall event efficiency.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Previous experience in event coordination, hospitality, venue operations, or event production.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working independently and taking initiative.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs, Drive, and Calendar.
* Availability for flexible scheduling, including evenings and weekends.
* Ability to work on-site in San Francisco as required.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in event venues, nightlife, corporate events, or live entertainment.
* Familiarity with event run-of-shows, floor plans, vendor coordination, and production logistics.
* Experience supporting multiple events at different stages of planning simultaneously.
* Familiarity with audiovisual production, venue operations, and event staffing.

What We're Looking For

Our ideal candidate is someone who enjoys both the organizational side of event planning and the energy of seeing an event come to life.

You're comfortable managing spreadsheets and timelines one day and coordinating vendors and setup on-site the next. You're proactive, communicative, adaptable, and capable of keeping things moving without needing constant direction.

Most importantly, you're someone who takes ownership of the details and understands that successful events depend on preparation, communication, and teamwork.

Schedule & Compensation

* Part-time, hourly position.
* **Hours vary based on confirmed event bookings and production needs.**
* Hybrid structure with a combination of remote administrative work and required on-site responsibilities.
* Evening, weekend, and occasional late-night availability required.
* Compensation based on relevant experience and qualifications.

**Please note:** This is not a traditional fixed-schedule position. We encourage candidates seeking flexible, event-based work to apply, particularly those comfortable with fluctuations in weekly hours.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction outlining your relevant event experience, availability, and interest in this type of flexible, event-driven role.

We look forward to meeting candidates who are excited to help bring a diverse range of events to life at 715 Harrison.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized **Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)** to join our growing clinical research team. In this role, you will coordinate and oversee the day-to-day operations of clinical trials, ensuring studies are conducted in compliance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), sponsor requirements, and regulatory guidelines.

You will work closely with Principal Investigators, sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and clinical staff to ensure the successful execution of research studies while maintaining the highest standards of participant safety and data integrity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Study Coordination**

* Coordinate and execute clinical trial visits according to study protocols and timelines.
* Screen, recruit, consent, and enroll eligible study participants.
* Perform study-related procedures as delegated by the Principal Investigator.
* Collect, document, and maintain accurate source documentation and study data.
* Enter study data into electronic data capture (EDC) systems in a timely manner.
* Maintain study binders, regulatory files, and essential study documentation.

**Regulatory & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, IRB requirements, sponsor SOPs, and site policies.
* Prepare and submit IRB applications, amendments, continuing reviews, and reportable events.
* Maintain complete and audit-ready regulatory documentation throughout each study.

**Sponsor & Monitor Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for sponsors, CROs, and study monitors.
* Coordinate and support site initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits.
* Respond to monitoring findings and complete follow-up action items.

**Participant Management**

* Educate participants on study procedures and expectations.
* Schedule participant visits and coordinate follow-up appointments.
* Ensure participant confidentiality, safety, and protocol compliance throughout the study.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Nursing, or a related field (or equivalent clinical research experience).
* 1–2 years of clinical research experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and FDA regulations.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple studies and deadlines simultaneously.

**Preferred**

* Experience using Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.
* Experience with eRegulatory platforms.
* Experience working in multi-site or high-volume clinical research settings.
* Phlebotomy, ECG, or other relevant clinical certifications.

If you are passionate about clinical research and committed to maintaining the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance, we encourage you to apply.

Pay: $28.00 - $33.00 per hour

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About The Information**

The Information is the go-to source of in-depth reporting for the most influential leaders in technology and business. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, our original, high-quality journalism has the power to inform the most consequential decisions shaping our future, and we’ve built a community of 700,000 active readers who depend on us to do just that. We have a financially healthy business, plenty of capital, and big ambitions to grow our team and business.

**About the role**

This is a chance to work at the intersection of tech and media as a key member of The Information’s events team. You’ll help run about 40 virtual and in-person events a year, and as we grow, you’ll build the systems that help us scale.

This role is for someone who thrives on running several things at once. On any given week, you might be finalizing a private dinner guest list, designing signage for next month’s summit, and spinning up a virtual event around breaking news, all while keeping the events inbox under control.

**What you'll do**

* Manage multiple events and projects simultaneously, often at different stages, switching between them throughout the day and reprioritizing as things change
* Own the events inbox: check the events alias daily, respond quickly, and route questions from subscribers, vendors, sponsors and guests to the right teammates
* Own the event signage process: create and update signage in Figma, prepare print-ready files, and keep materials on brand, with support from the Graphics team
* Run end-to-end logistics and production for virtual events in a fast-paced, news-driven environment: coordinate speaker communications, set up Zoom, manage live sessions, and pivot quickly as news and priorities evolve
* Build and improve the processes, templates and databases that help the events team scale
* Curate audiences for intimate events by researching executives who fit each event’s profile
* Manage RSVPs for private dinners, send customized invitations to executives, and maintain a database of invitations across events
* Research venues and maintain a venue database for key markets
* Handle day-to-day correspondence with external vendors, including requesting quotes
* Track budgets and event expenses and submit invoices promptly
* Partner with Account Managers to support event sponsors and deliver sponsor commitments on time
* Work regularly with the Brand Partnerships, Growth, and Engineering teams
* Track competing events and keep a running list of upcoming events in tech and media
* Handle post-event follow-up, such as attendee surveys, recaps, and closing out budgets

**Qualifications**

Our ideal candidate is responsive and proactive. You’re very detail-oriented, stay calm under pressure, and have good instincts for what’s needed next. You work well with both outside partners and internal teams, and you’ll be a big part of keeping our growing events team running smoothly.

* A track record of planning ahead, spotting problems before they happen, and prioritizing when everything feels urgent.
* 3–5 years of event planning experience, preferably in tech, media, finance/venture capital, or PR
* Familiarity with Figma or similar design tools, with experience creating and/or editing event signage or print materials
* Experience with tools such as Zoom, Eventbrite, and Claude
* Very strong attention to detail and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Ability to travel domestically about 1–3 times per quarter, depending on the time of year
* Ability to frequently lift up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation

**Why Join Us?**

At *The Information*, you’ll have the opportunity to work with a team of passionate professionals, shaping the future of tech and business journalism. We’re committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive environment where innovative ideas thrive. If you’re excited about the chance to make an impact with your marketing expertise and help grow a brand that’s setting the standard for quality journalism, we’d love to hear from you.

**Benefits**

**We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the well-being of our employees and their families, including:**

* Company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents
* Medical coverage that includes fertility care and $0 copays for in-office mental health visits with in-network providers
* Paid parental leave to support and empower new parents
* Generous paid time off (PTO) that increases with tenure

* Fitness and wellness stipend to encourage a healthy lifestyle
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement
* Company-sponsored lunches in the office every Monday
* Commuter benefits

**We can only accept applications from those eligible to live and work in the United States. This is a hybrid role with office attendance required 3 days/week.**

jobs.title: Content Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Content Production Coordinator**

**About Cypherpunk**

At Cypherpunk Technologies (Cypherpunk), our mission is to advance technologies that guarantee privacy for humans on the internet. As a privacy technology company, Cypherpunk pursues this mission through three primary strategies: mining Zcash through Cypherpunk Mining; accumulating Zcash through open market purchases; and investing in, acquiring, and building technologies that push the frontier of privacy forward.

We are a small, ambitious team focused on building the future of privacy. We believe meaningful progress comes from people who are passionate about the mission, willing to challenge assumptions, and ready to adapt as technology and the industry evolve.

We value individuals who take ownership, move quickly, and turn ideas into results. Collaboration is central to how we operate, and every team member has a direct impact on our success. We encourage thoughtful debate, value different perspectives, and believe the best work happens when talented people genuinely enjoy working together.

We're building something important, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what comes next. If you're excited by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving industry, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the role**

Privacy is one of the defining fights of the internet, and most people have never heard the case for it told well. That’s where you come in. As Content Production Coordinator, you’ll run the engine behind Cypherpunk’s long-form content: the videos, podcasts, interviews, and deep dives that explain what we’re building and why it matters. You’ll take every piece from idea to publish, then turn it into clips, threads, and posts built for each platform’s algorithm, so the right people find it and stick around.

You’re terminally online, you know what makes a post hit vs. flop, and you can tell a trend is played out before everyone else does. You’ll back up your instincts with the numbers and make every post hit harder than the last. You’ll own this from day one. Your work will shape how Cypherpunk sounds, looks, and shows up online, for everyone from crypto natives to people thinking about privacy for the first time.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate long-form content from idea to publish: scheduling recordings, prepping guests and hosts, tracking edits, and keeping the content calendar on time
* Cut long-form pieces into clips, threads, and posts tailored to each platform (X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and whatever’s next)
* Write titles, thumbnail briefs, hooks, captions, and descriptions built to perform
* Track what’s working using platform analytics (watch time, retention, CTR, engagement) and use it to shape what we make next
* Keep a pulse on trends, formats, and conversations in crypto, privacy, and tech culture, and bring ideas to the team
* Manage assets, file organization, and publishing workflows so nothing slips
* Work with freelancers (editors, designers) on deliverables and timelines

**What we’re looking for**

* Experience in content, social media, or media production. A channel you’ve grown or work for a creator or brand counts as much as a job title
* Chronically online: you know the platforms, the formats, the memes, and the culture, and you can tell what will land with an audience
* A working understanding of how social media algorithms surface content, and how hooks, retention, posting cadence, and packaging affect reach
* A real appreciation for long-form content (YouTube, podcasts, deep-dive videos) and how to build an audience around it
* Strong organization and follow-through: you can juggle many moving pieces and hit deadlines
* Clear, sharp writing with a feel for voice and tone
* Curiosity about privacy, crypto, and the people building in these spaces (no technical background required)

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on video editing experience (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Descript)
* Experience with thumbnail design or tools like Figma or Canva
* A portfolio, channel, or account you’ve grown, with examples of content that performed
* Familiarity with crypto Twitter, the Zcash community, or privacy and cypherpunk culture
* Experience with podcast production or live streams

Compensation Range: $75K - $125K

jobs.title: Client Services Help Desk
jobs.description:
### **Description**

The Client Services Helpdesk professional serves as a frontline resource for users who need prompt, courteous, and effective technical support. In this role, you will respond to requests for assistance in person, by phone, and through support channels, while troubleshooting hardware, software, and basic system issues. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with sound technical judgment, maintains accurate documentation, and delivers reliable support that helps end users remain productive. This position also plays an important role in escalating complex issues appropriately, following standard operating procedures, and contributing to a positive client support experience.  
  
This is an onsite role in Manhattan, NY.

The ideal candidate will bring 2–5 years of experience in a helpdesk, desktop support, or technical support environment, with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot common hardware, software, and user-access issues effectively. This individual should be comfortable working directly with end users, managing multiple requests, and maintaining a service-oriented approach in a fast-paced setting. Basic industry certifications are a plus and may include credentials such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft fundamentals, or similar entry-level technical certifications.

On a typical day, this role involves monitoring incoming support requests and assisting users with a wide range of technical needs. You will communicate with end users to gather relevant details, troubleshoot problems methodically, document actions taken, and ensure each issue is followed through to completion or properly escalated. Success in this role requires balancing responsiveness with accuracy, maintaining a professional and helpful demeanor, and contributing to a dependable support experience that reflects the standards of the Client Services team.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as the first point of contact for end users and client IT staff seeking technical assistance.
* Respond to inbound incidents and service requests through phone, email, ticketing systems, and in-person support.
* Troubleshoot and resolve basic to intermediate hardware, software, connectivity, and account access issues in a timely manner.
* Maintain end-to-end ownership of support requests, ensuring timely follow-up, clear communication, and appropriate resolution.
* Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and user interactions accurately within the designated support system.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to the appropriate support teams in accordance with established procedures.
* Provide users with clear, easy-to-understand guidance and updates throughout the support process.
* Assist with setup, configuration, and basic maintenance of workstations, peripherals, and standard business applications.
* Monitor support queues and address tickets based on SOP.
* Participate in and adhere to all standard operating procedures, service standards, and departmental policies.
* Identify recurring issues and share feedback or improvement opportunities with the broader support team.
* Support a professional, service-oriented environment by demonstrating patience, accountability, and responsiveness in all client interactions.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Strong customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to diagnose and resolve common technical issues efficiently and accurately.
* Working knowledge of desktop operating systems, business applications, printers, mobile devices, and basic networking concepts.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting incidents and resolutions.
* Ability to prioritize multiple requests and work effectively in a fast-paced support environment.
* Commitment to following procedures, maintaining professionalism, and delivering a high-quality support experience.

  

### **About Liss Technologies**

LISS Technologies provides the expert IT support your business needs to solve the technology challenges of today and provide a clear roadmap for the future.

Your business is like no other. As your trusted IT provider, we function as an extension of your business by taking your goals and culture into account and working tirelessly to provide the technology you need to get the job done. The basis of a true IT partnership is trust. Trust that we have the knowledge and experience to guide your technology decisions. Trust in our processes to be refined and customized to your needs. And, most importantly, trust that we always have your goals and interests in mind.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Catsy is a combined PIM (product information management) and DAM (digital asset management) platform. Industrial manufacturers, wholesale distributors and B2B brands use it to keep product data and images accurate and to publish them to their websites, catalogs and retail partners. Our AI-native tools, including an MCP integration with Claude, help customers do in minutes what used to take their teams weeks.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager, you own a book of Catsy customers from signed contract to renewal. You'll make sure each one goes live on time, gets real value from Catsy, and renews and grows with us.

You'll be the customer's main point of contact. You'll learn their catalog, their channels and their goals, then work with our sales, product and support teams to get them what they need. You'll use account data to spot risk early and find the next step that helps each customer most.

What you'll do

* **Own customer relationships.** Be the main point of contact for your accounts. Learn each customer's goals, workflows and concerns, and build trust with both day-to-day users and executives.
* **Lead onboarding and go-live.** Run kickoff, set the plan and dates, and coordinate data imports, channel setup and training so customers launch on schedule.
* **Drive adoption and value.** Check in regularly, run business reviews, and show customers how to get more from Catsy, such as faster product launches, cleaner data and new channels.
* **Manage renewals and growth.** Own renewal timing and spot expansion opportunities, such as more users, SKUs, channels or modules. Bring sales in when an upsell is ready.
* **Coordinate across teams.** Work with sales, product, support and client services to resolve issues, follow requests through to completion, and pass customer feedback to the product team.
* **Keep accounts organized.** Track activity, orders, account updates and follow-ups in Salesforce and other CRM tools, so anyone on the team can see where an account stands.
* **Use data to act early.** Review usage, support tickets and feedback to find at-risk accounts and growth opportunities, then act on what you find.

What you'll bring

* 3+ years in customer success, account management or client services, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
* Experience owning a book of accounts through onboarding, adoption and renewal.
* Clear writing and speaking, with customers and internal teams alike. You can explain technical topics in plain language.
* Strong organization and project management. You can run several onboardings at once without dropping details.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM, plus Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
* Comfort with account data. You can read usage trends and use them to decide what to do next.
* A problem-solving mindset and real care for how customers' businesses do.

Nice to have

* Experience with PIM, DAM, ecommerce or product data tools.
* Familiarity with manufacturing, wholesale distribution or B2B retail.
* Knowledge of sales channels such as Shopify, BigCommerce, Amazon or retailer portals.
* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or another customer success platform.
* Interest in AI tools and how they change everyday work.

How we'll measure success

* Customers go live on the date agreed at kickoff.
* Gross and net revenue retention across your book of accounts.
* Product adoption, including active users, SKUs managed and channels connected.
* Customer satisfaction, through CSAT or NPS.
* Expansion revenue you identify and pass to sales.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brooklyn, NY 11201

Compliance is the wedge. * Have real input into the outbound playbook as we refine, together, what actually works in this market.

* **Contract Arrangement:** Starts as a 1099 Independent Contractor with a pathway to transition into W-2 employment (20–35 hours per week at the outset; adaptable schedule with consistent daily overlap during US Eastern Time)

### **Company Background**

We are a rapidly expanding, founder-led US financial advisory and corporate services practice based in Florida. Our core purpose is to open up the world's most lucrative financial ecosystem for international founders through US business entity formation, in-person US banking access, business credit establishment, and customized concierge support. Rather than focusing solely on credit cards, we deliver long-term access, expansion, and financial independence.  
Running with a compact, remote-first team of 2 to 10 professionals, our culture is built on trust, candor, and practical, high-caliber execution free from micromanagement. Standing out as the sole German-speaking advisory offering hands-on US banking setup, we serve a genuine "Blue Ocean" niche with premium packages priced between $5,000 and $20,000, backed by a warm pipeline of more than 1,500 existing prospects.  
As our inaugural dedicated sales team member, you will partner directly with the Founder & CEO to re-activate warm prospects, vet high-potential founders, and grow top-line revenue. You will begin by serving as a Setter—scheduling qualified strategy sessions—with a clear, accelerated trajectory toward closing your own five-figure agreements and eventually moving into a Sales Manager role.

### **Core Duties & Responsibilities**

* **Warm Pipeline Re-Engagement:** Reach back out to and nurture an established pool of over 1,500 warm contacts via email, WhatsApp, phone, and LinkedIn—eliminating the need to build cold outreach lists from scratch.
* **Prospect Vetting:** Assess incoming leads (including those generated through Meta campaigns) and outbound contacts against our Ideal Client Profile (ICP) criteria.
* **Appointment Setting:** Schedule 8 to 12 qualified strategy and analysis meetings each week straight onto the founder's calendar.
* **CRM & Pipeline Discipline:** Keep pipeline data clean and up to date inside Close.io by advancing deal stages, running structured follow-up cadences, and maintaining reliable reporting.
* **Deal Advancement & Closing:** Follow up consistently on active proposals so opportunities do not stall from lack of contact, moving into closing your own $5k–$15k sales while monitoring conversion rates.
* **Post-Sale Handoff:** Work hand in hand with operations colleagues so new clients experience a smooth onboarding transition after closing.

### **Qualifications & Candidate Profile**

* **Languages:** Native fluency in German (C2) combined with business-level English (C1+) across both speaking and writing.
* **Residency & Work Eligibility:** Living in the US Eastern Time (EST) zone with valid US work authorization and dependable daily availability during EST business hours.
* **Sales Track Record:** At least 1 to 2+ years of demonstrated success in high-ticket B2B sales or SDR/AE roles (such as consulting, financial services, coaching, or SaaS), with proven ability to work or close deals in the $5,000–$15,000+ range and handle objections. *(Entry-level BDR or strictly call-center backgrounds will not be considered.)*
* **Domain Interest & Commercial Mindset:** Authentic enthusiasm for banking, finance, credit building, and cross-border entrepreneurship, paired with the initiative to thoroughly learn how our business works.
* **Autonomous Remote Execution:** Highly organized, results-driven, and self-sufficient—able to succeed independently without daily check-ins or heavy oversight, measured by outcomes rather than clock-watching.
* **Tools & Systems:** Strong habits around CRM usage (prior Close.io experience is a plus), along with practical familiarity using WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Zapier, and Mailchimp for multi-channel outreach.

### **Benefits & Perks**

* **Ready-to-Work Pipeline:** Step right into momentum with 1,500+ existing warm leads alongside actively scaling Meta ad acquisition.
* **High Earning Potential & Advancement:** Competitive base compensation up to $50,000 coupled with uncapped commission and a fast-moving career ladder from Setter to Closer to Sales Manager.
* **Direct Founder Access & Ownership:** Help shape the sales playbook and workflows from day one as the first dedicated sales hire working closely with the CEO.
* **Schedule Freedom & Gatherings:** Completely remote work with flexible hours, plus optional company-paid team and client gatherings in Miami once or twice a year (and potential US visa pathways for standout performers).
* **Distinctive Offer & Caliber of Clients:** Represent a high-demand, low-competition service while speaking daily with driven entrepreneurs across the DACH region and global markets.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (Associate), OCEO
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant (Associate), OCEO**

*Acumen is seeking an Executive Assistant to provide exceptionally reliable, detail-oriented support to the CEO and the Office of the CEO (OCEO). This is more than an administrative role: it calls for strong judgment, discretion, and anticipation. Reliability and clear communication are central to the role. Acumen's New York office operates on a hybrid schedule, with in-office work Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.*

  

**About Acumen**

Acumen is a global force of entrepreneurs, investors, philanthropists, and social innovators working together to build a world based on dignity. We were founded by Jacqueline Novogratz on the radical idea that business, when cultivated with moral imagination, can break the cycle of poverty. We invest in transformational companies, sustainable markets, and prepare leaders with the tools they need to create a more just and inclusive future. Since 2001, we have scaled companies and shaped markets in some of the hardest-to-reach communities on the planet, impacting over half-a-billion lives. To learn more visit acumen.org.

  

**About the Office of the CEO**

The Office of the CEO (OCEO) enables Jacqueline Novogratz to engage effectively across Acumen and with external stakeholders. The team works in close partnership across executive strategy, engagement, operations, and administrative execution, with clear decision rights and shared visibility.

  

**About the Role**

The Executive Assistant carries out logistics, travel, and administrative support for Jacqueline Novogratz, who travels roughly 60 to 70 percent of the year. The role also provides in-person support in the New York office. It reports to the Manager, Executive Operations, who is the focal point for scheduling, and works closely with the Chief of Staff.

  

**Accountabilities Include:**

  

***Logistics and in-person support***

* Executes day-to-day scheduling across time zones at the Manager's direction, and supports scheduling for the Chief of Staff as needed
* Supports high-volume communications and inbox management with discernment, helping prioritize, draft, and respond, and escalating to the Manager when needed
* Provides in-person support when Jacqueline is in the New York office, keeping her day on track, ensuring smooth transitions between meetings, and preparing her briefing binder
* Coordinates logistics for dinners, salons, and other events in partnership with the Manager
* Supports coordination with external organizations and initiatives Jacqueline is engaged with, as directed by the Manager

  

***Travel***

* Books Jacqueline's travel once the Manager has confirmed trip details, researching options, handling routine changes, applying her preferences, and flagging constraints early
* Prepares travel packs with itineraries, meeting schedules, clearance materials, and relevant background, and secures visas, passport pages, and other documents well ahead of international trips
* Handles travel logistics for board trips in partnership with the Manager and the Chief of Staff

  

***Relationship support and correspondence***

* Supports the Manager on the outreach cadence and quarterly correspondence review, tracking follow-up and preparing inputs ahead of each review
* Supports the Manager on inbound and outbound correspondence through the CEO's inbox
* Drafts follow-up correspondence in partnership with the Chief of Staff

  

***Research and media monitoring***

* Monitors the press and news on key contacts, flagging relevant coverage and escalating material developments to the OCEO team
* Conducts relationship-tracking research ahead of board trips and key meetings, and provides memo and research support
* Takes on additional assignments as needed, including operational support

  

***Expenses, invoices, timesheets, and documents***

* Prepares and tracks expense reports and processes invoices and expenses in accordance with Acumen's Travel & Expense Policy
* Reviews and advises on expense reports for the CEO and her direct reports.
* Manages the CEO's timesheets
* Coordinates with Talent, Legal, and Finance on contracts, signatures, approvals, and related documentation, and tracks signatures and information for CEO-related documents through to delivery

  

***Briefings, meetings, and projects***

* Helps prepare briefings and talking points
* Schedules and supports logistics for the standing meeting with Development & Partnerships and the regional focal points
* Supports the Chief of Staff and the Manager on special projects as needed

  

**How the Role Operates**

  

**Reliability, accuracy, and clear communication are core expectations of this role, not extras.**

* Proactive communication. Keeps the Manager continuously informed, and the Chief of Staff when working with her directly. Surfaces changes, conflicts, risks, and open questions early, without waiting to be asked.
* Responsiveness. Responds in a timely, consistent, and reliable manner, especially when working remotely. Is a clear communicator who makes it easy to see what is needed and by when.
* A consistent rhythm. Joins the weekly team sync with the Chief of Staff and the Manager, and the Monday look-ahead, so support is integrated rather than siloed.
* Attention to detail. Delivers expense reports, timesheets, documents, and correspondence that are accurate, complete, and ready without rework, in line with Acumen policies.
* Consistency. Delivers the same high standard every week, not just during busy periods, so the Manager and the Chief of Staff can rely on the work without checking it.
* Follow-through. Closes the loop on every request, tracks signatures and approvals through to completion, and flags anything delayed or unresolved before it becomes a problem.
* Sound judgment. Knows what needs escalation and brings it to the Manager early, with a recommendation where possible. Stays calm when plans change.
* Discretion. Handles confidential and sensitive info

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
BDR & Sales Coordinator

**About ChainIT**

ChainIT Inc. builds verification-first infrastructure for identity, agreements, payments and assets. Our philosophy is simple: nothing is assumed, and everything is verified. Every party is verified before value or data moves, and every transaction and every agent action leaves an immutable, append-only record. We hold 15 U.S. patents.

One platform connects our products. ChainIT ID verifies each party, Pactvera binds the terms, ChainIT Pay moves the value and Valitorum proves it.

We're a growth-phase company, and our products, features and SOPs are evolving weekly, often daily. We are builders. If you want a front-row seat to what gets built next in identity and payments, read on.

**The role**

The BDR & Sales Coordinator builds pipeline across ChainIT's product lines and keeps the commercial engine running. You'll research prospects and reach out to them, qualify leads and book meetings. Then you'll keep every opportunity moving through the CRM, the calendar and the follow-up. You'll report directly to ChainIT's Chief Commercial Officer (CCO), which gives you a front-row view of executive leadership, commercial strategy and client relationships.

**What you'll do**

* Research the market. Find target accounts and the right contacts, and build prospect lists for ChainIT's products.
* Run outbound outreach by email, phone and LinkedIn.
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads, and book discovery meetings for the CCO and the commercial team.
* Follow up after every call and meeting so no opportunity stalls.
* Log activity, update contacts and deal stages, and keep pipeline data accurate.
* Schedule and coordinate prospect meetings, demos and internal commercial calls.
* Prepare materials, call notes and follow-up summaries for the CCO.
* Help with conference logistics, attendee lists and booking on-site meetings.
* Complete all required trainings and use the tools provided to the expected level, including company AI platforms and agent management.

**What you bring**

We care most about finding people who fit our team and share our drive to learn and grow. Whether you have many years of experience or none, if this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply.

*Required*

* You're curious about building a career in sales and business development. You don't need prior sales experience.
* You enjoy learning, welcome feedback and like seeing yourself improve over time.
* You prefer solving problems together to assigning blame, which matters at a growing company like ours.
* You're comfortable picking up new systems and tools, and you take the initiative with training and your own development.
* You're eager to learn the tools we use, including AI platforms like Claude Cowork and agent management. We provide training.
* You're organized. You can keep track of multiple tasks, follow-ups and deadlines at once.
* You communicate clearly. You write and speak professionally, including with prospects and senior leaders.
* You can work a hybrid schedule, from our Scottsdale office 2 to 3 days a week.

*What sets you apart*

* A bachelor's degree in business, marketing or communications, or you've recently graduated in one of those fields.
* An internship or first role in sales, business development or customer-facing work.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.
* An interest in digital identity, fintech, payments or compliance.

**What we offer**

* **Salary and benefits:** Compensation and benefits depend on where you're located, and we'll go through the full details with you during the interview process. ChainIT pays for your medical, dental and vision coverage, so there's no employee premium for your own coverage. You also get paid time off.
* **ChainIT University:** our internal training program on the platform, our products and the identity and compliance rules behind them.

**How hiring works**

* Intro call with our Recruiting Coordinator or VP, Talent & Culture (25 minutes)
* Role conversation with ChainIT's Chief Commercial Officer (30 to 45 minutes)
* Team conversations, so you can make sure the role is right for you (30 minutes)

**Is this role for you?**

This role is a great fit if you're excited to launch a sales career, learn directly from ChainIT's Chief Commercial Officer and pick up the phone to start real conversations. You'll thrive here if you enjoy figuring things out as you go in a fast-growing environment, and if you want to learn how we're building verification-first identity and payments for the agentic era.

Pay: $45,600.00 - $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
