jobs.description:
Stratix Corporation is the trusted advisor for many industry-leading global enterprises, offering the most comprehensive managed services portfolio to help companies operationalize and realize the full value of their mobile investments. Our passion is partnering with businesses to operationalize their mobile investments with high-value services that drive competitive differentiation.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Customer Success Manager owns the ongoing client relationship and account health for enterprise mobility programs where wireless carriers, including Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile, are a core part of the solution. This role is part of the program from day one and works hand in hand with a dedicated Program Manager. The Program Manager leads program delivery and execution, while the Customer Success Manager handles all customer service inquiries and owns client satisfaction, ongoing service, and long-term account growth.

The Customer Success Manager is the client’s day-to-day advocate, both inside Stratix and with carrier partners, making sure carrier-related issues are resolved quickly, service levels are met, and the client gets full value from their mobility investment.

**Carrier experience is required.** Candidates must have direct, hands-on experience working with one or more major U.S. wireless carriers (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, or similar) in an enterprise or B2B setting.

**Location:** Peachtree Corners, Georgia. This is a 100% onsite position.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Join the program from day one as a core member of the program team, taking part in kickoff, requirements gathering, and planning alongside the Program Manager.
* Serve as the client’s single point of contact for all customer service inquiries, including orders, device and activation issues, returns, and carrier service and billing questions, throughout the life of the program.
* Act as the client’s advocate with carrier account teams (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile), working with carrier representatives to resolve service, order, activation, and billing issues.
* Monitor day-to-day operations during both active projects and steady state, including carrier orders, activations, upgrades, device replacements, and returns, so that SLAs and client expectations are met.
* Advise clients on carrier topics such as rate plan optimization, upgrade eligibility and timing, promotions, and carrier credits.
* Track account health through KPIs, SLAs, CSAT, and escalation trends. Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews together with the Program Manager.
* Own customer service escalations from intake through resolution, coordinating across Order Management, Warehouse, Staging, Shipping, and Support.
* Partner with the Program Manager throughout delivery and into steady state so the client experience stays consistent, and maintain account documentation, runbooks, and contact maps.
* Support carrier billing reconciliation, invoice questions, and dispute resolution with Finance and carrier partners.
* Identify renewal, expansion, and change order opportunities, and partner with Sales and the Program Manager to bring them forward.
* Keep account records, weekly updates, and backlog forecasts current in ServiceNow and other Stratix systems.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* **Required:** Direct experience working with major U.S. wireless carriers (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile) on enterprise or business accounts. Candidates may come from the carrier side, a carrier partner or reseller, or a managed mobility provider.
* Minimum of 5 years of customer success, account management, or client services experience in a customer-facing environment.
* Working knowledge of carrier business processes, including activations, porting, rate plans, device upgrades and financing, carrier portals, and carrier billing, credits, and disputes.
* Experience with enterprise mobility, managed mobility services, or device lifecycle programs preferred.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships with client executives, lead business reviews, and manage escalations to resolution.
* Commercial awareness, with experience supporting renewals, expansions, or account growth.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work in tandem with a Program Manager from program kickoff onward, sharing ownership of the client relationship.
* Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP) and proficiency in PowerPoint and Word.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Oracle, a CRM such as Salesforce, or MDM platforms (SOTI, Knox, Intune, etc.) is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, empathy, and conflict resolution skills.
* Highly organized and detail oriented, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities.

**Required Education & Experience:**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Enterprise wireless carrier experience (required).
* Customer Success or Account Management in a customer/client-facing environment.

* Collaborate with umbrella FACE Office departments to advance family engagement strategy and vision.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About CodeHS**
----------------

CodeHS is a comprehensive platform helping K-12 schools teach computer science. We provide curriculum, professional development, and a full software platform. CodeHS is used by millions of students and thousands of schools and districts around the US and the world.

**Mission**
-----------

**The mission of CodeHS is to empower all students to meaningfully impact the future.** We believe that in the 21st century, coding is a foundational skill, just like reading and writing. That’s why we say: **Read, Write, Code.** Coding and computer science are essential skills for students to learn and schools to teach.

**About the role**

CodeHS is looking for an Account Manager to help manage and renew customer accounts.

You will get a chance to work closely with educators and schools to facilitate teaching coding to students all over the world.

**Location: This role is a 5 days a week office role in the CodeHS Chicago Office in River North.**

**What you'll do**

* The primary responsibility is to renew customer accounts
* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts
* Handle upsells and additional orders and expansions for existing customers
* Work with teachers and administrators on CodeHS implementation
* Have a deep understanding of the CodeHS product
* Closely track and manage account data
* Keep and maintain data in a CRM for renewals reporting and projections
* Meet with school and district administrators on account check ins
* Work with school administrators and other stakeholders to improve computer science programs
* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers on account implementation

**Qualifications**

* Passionate about improving access to quality education
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Extremely organized and detail oriented
* Interest in personally learning more about coding, prior experience a plus
* 2 years sales experience
* Account Management or Edtech sales or account management experience preferred
* 5-10% travel, company/department meet ups are approximately quarterly and there may be conference or customer travel

You're a great fit for this position if you are passionate about improving education, building strong relationships, going the extra mile to solve problems creatively, and working on the forefront to use technology to improve education.

**Location**  
  

* Full Office - This role is a 5 days a week office role in the CodeHS Chicago Office in River North.

**Compensation**  
Total Compensation including Base Salary and Commissions:

$85,000 - $115,000

### **Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with 4% match
* Paid parental leave
* Strong vacation policy (22 days off + 16 company holidays)
* Short-term and long-term disability
* CTA monthly pass covered
* Lunch provided 3 days per week

**Company Values**
------------------

#### **Encourage Teaching and Learning**

CodeHS is about providing excellent teaching and learning opportunities in computer science for students all over the world. We value creating fun, accessible and creative learning experiences for teachers, for students, and for team members at CodeHS. We believe that education-and specifically coding-within the formal K-12 system, the higher-education system, and beyond has the power to allow everyone to unlock their full potential.

#### **Create a Direct Positive Impact**

At CodeHS we value creating a direct positive social impact with our work. We work directly with students, teachers, schools and districts to implement computer science classes. Through building great curriculum, tools and resources to allow high schools to teach computer science, we can create a direct educational benefit to students to help explore the limitless world of computing. We believe that expanding access to computer science education will empower students to take an active role in creating the future.

#### **Make It Fun and Creative**

Bringing fun and creativity to every aspect of our work is a main focus for us at CodeHS. It starts with a fun, friendly and accessible curriculum, that allows students the opportunity to build creatively and engage in thoughtful problem solving. We also focus on developing a creative and fun environment to work in, and think that this allows us to bring novel approaches to challenging problems. Computing is about logic-but it’s also about creativity-and we hope to share that excitement with teachers and students through CodeHS.

**Our Operating Practices**

**Get the job done**

We figure out the real problem to be solved and take ownership over seeing it to completion. We help move things across the finish line.

**Bring context and big picture awareness**

We consider the projects we work on in their context and see how our projects impact the team, company, and the customer.

**Adaptable**

We adapt to changing needs across customers and the team, and make good plans but know that they can change as we get new information.

**Growth Mindset**

We're always looking to learn and improve, and we share that mindset with teachers and students. We’re working to improve individually and as a team.

**Team player**

We help out our teammates and we’re team players. We make decisions with a team first approach and strive to act in the best interest of the company as a whole.

**Constructive and solution oriented**

When approached with problems and roadblocks, we're constructive and solution oriented. We think through problems and tradeoffs, proactively finding solutions.

**Good vibes**

We bring positive energy whether in person or virtually to help contribute to making a positive work environment for everyone.

**Follow through**

We make sure to do what we say we are going to do for team members and for customers. We're proactive, dependable and reliable in the work that we do.

CodeHS is an equal opportunity employer. CodeHS maintains a drug-free workplace.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager | TASK Force East
jobs.description:
Chervon is one of the world’s leading outdoor power equipment manufacturers with a rich history of innovation. Chervon’s commitment to build a better world by building better tools is evident in the products we manufacture and our green approach to manufacturing. We design, engineer, and market outdoor power equipment within our brand portfolio. Supported by world-class R&D, design, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing, sales, and service teams throughout the world, Chervon delivers innovative solutions to professionals and consumers around the world.

Our portfolio’s cornerstone brand, EGO, is helping transform the outdoor power equipment industry through advanced battery-powered technology, delivering professional-grade performance without the traditional dependence on gas-powered equipment. As we expand our presence in the commercial outdoor power equipment market, we are seeking ambitious, results-driven sales professionals who thrive on developing new business, challenging conventional thinking, and delivering unprecedented growth.

**Summary of Responsibilities:**

The Regional Task Force Key Account Manager supporting EGO Commercial is responsible for connecting with End Users and driving profitable sales growth, increasing market share, uncovering high-value conversion opportunities, and expanding Chervon's presence within the professional landscaping market. This role requires a highly motivated sales professional with a hunter mentality who proactively identifies new business opportunities, reaches out and creates relationships with new users, demonstrates product features and benefits, converts competitor products, and drives adoption of Chervon brands. The successful candidate combines strategic account management with aggressive business development to deliver sustainable revenue and profit growth. They must possess a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability while thriving in a fast-paced, result-oriented environment.

This high-visibility role will allow this candidate to become one of the key faces of our TASK Force implementing each of the core principles this national team sets out to redefine through Trials, Awareness, Solutions, & Knowledge.

**Key Job Responsibilities:**

* Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities with incremental contractors, trade organizations, and key institutions.
* Hunt for large-scale, strategic conversion opportunities through consultative sales process and in-field discovery
* Establish yourself as a product expert and sales strategist through collaboration with distribution partners to identify opportunities, execute strategic promotions or programs, and expand EGO Commercial’s market penetration
* Expand product assortment of current customers, thus driving stronger distribution support.
* Lead annual and multi-year growth strategies focused on market share gains and customer expansion.
* Deliver concise & impactful hands-on product demonstrations, technical training, and sales education to distributor teams and end users to strengthen product knowledge and position our solutions as the right choice
* Challenge the status quo and pursue opportunities beyond existing business relationships.
* Deliver against aggressive sales, margin, and market penetration objectives.
* Builds executive-level customer relationships while maintaining a relentless focus on results and accountability.
* Develop and execute territory business plans, prioritize opportunities, and maintain a pipeline to achieve sales goals while gaining market share.
* Execute customer-specific growth plans aligned with sales, distribution, and product development.
* Owns annual sales plans, forecasts, and performance against targets.
* Must work cross-functionally with service, marketing, and product development teams on product offering, pricing, promotions, conversion programs, and after-sales support
* Works closely with product management to maintain a robust and comprehensive product road map for the channel

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field
* 5+ years of successful sales, account management, or business development experience.
* Proven track record of growing sales, expanding distribution, and delivering profitable market share gains.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and close new business opportunities with contractors and multi-account management.
* Experience presenting, negotiating, and influencing decisions at all levels of customer organizations.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills within all levels of an organization
* Strong understanding of sales forecasting; financial management; merchandising
* Excellent business management and developmental skills

**Travel:**

This position requires a majority of your time traveling throughout the week; along with some weekend and evening events. 70% or more.

**Work Environment:**

Chervon North America operates in a casual and fun environment. We offer a very competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, short/long-term disability, life insurance, parental leave, a generous 401(k) match, an open PTO program and a hybrid work environment.

*We think Chervon is a great place to work! Be part of our new future!* ***Better Tools. Better World.***

Chervon North America is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, age, religion, color, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, gender, pregnancy, military status, order of protection status, transgender status, genetic information, or any other category protected by law.

jobs.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

Workday’s Specialized Customer Success team helps customers drive adoption and realize value from our emerging products. This team supports our newest offering—a leading agentic identity platform for people and agents—helping organizations govern workforce access, deploy AI agents, and modernize their identity and access programs.
  
We’re growing our Customer Success team across Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial segments. With fewer than 10 people today, this is a team where you can help shape how we work, develop our people, and build the processes that let us scale as the business grows.
  
  
We're obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we're shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you'll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We're in this together, handling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you'll do meaningful work with Workmates who've got your back. In return, we'll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you've found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Role**

As a Manager, Customer Success – Agentic Identity, you will lead a team of Customer Success Managers across Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial segments. You will be accountable for net dollar retention across the full customer portfolio, partnering closely with Sales to retain customers and identify opportunities for growth.

  

This role is as much about building the team as leading it. You will establish hiring, onboarding, and ramp processes, develop repeatable playbooks, and coach CSMs to deliver the right engagement for each customer segment. You will take people development as seriously as customer outcomes, helping your team grow while building a Customer Success function that can scale.

  

**In this role, you will be responsible for:**

**Own.** Lead a team of CSMs spanning Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial segments. Be accountable for net dollar retention across the whole portfolio, not just one segment’s numbers.

**Grow.** Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities. Coach your team to identify upsell and cross-sell signals early, and step in when an expansion conversation needs leadership involvement.

**Build.** Establish the hiring, onboarding, and ramp processes the team needs to scale. With fewer than 10 people on the team today, help build the foundation for continued growth while managing capacity and coverage.

**Improve.** Build playbooks, customer health scoring, and Quarterly and Executive Business Review cadences that work across segments, while allowing for the different needs of Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial customers.

**Develop.** Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and manage performance for your direct reports. Identify opportunities for CSMs to take on greater responsibility and build development plans that help them get there.

**Drive Customer Outcomes:** Lead the team in accelerating platform adoption, measuring customer value, realization, and establishing repeatable success motions that connect customer outcome to retention, advocacy, and expansion.

**Lead cross functionally:** Partner with Sales, Deployment, Product, and the broader Workday Customer Success organization to align customer engagement , strengthen hand-offs, resolve systematic challenges, and deliver a connected customer experience

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related roles within B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* 3+ years of experience directly leading and developing a Customer Success or Account Management team.

**Other Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience owning and improving net dollar retention, beyond gross retention or customer satisfaction measures.
* Experience leading teams that support different customer segments, such as Strategic or Enterprise and Commercial or Mid-Market, with different account volumes, coverage models, and engagement cadences.
* Ability to partner closely with Sales on expansion, helping teams identify customer needs and opportunities for additional value.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager

**Walker Sands is one of the fastest-growing integrated B2B marketing agencies in the world. We are looking for a high-impact Social Media Manager to help fuel that continued growth. Total compensation for this role is expected to be between $50,000 and $55,100 per year.**

As an agency, we exist to accelerate growth—for our clients, our people and the B2B industry. We partner with B2B technology and services companies, from high-growth Silicon Valley businesses to global Fortune 500 brands, to drive meaningful business results. At Walker Sands, curiosity sparks new ideas, collaboration makes the work stronger, and people are at the center of everything we do.

We're looking for a Social Media Manager to join our Strategic Communications team and help clients build stronger brands, engage their audiences and drive meaningful business outcomes through social media.

In this role, you'll lead organic social strategy and execution for a portfolio of B2B clients, developing content plans, guiding creative development, managing social channels, and translating performance data into actionable recommendations. You'll work closely with account teams, strategists, copywriters, and designers to deliver thoughtful, creative social programs that connect with the audiences our clients want to reach.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with strong execution, brings fresh ideas to the table, and understands how social media shapes brand perception, credibility, and business growth.

* Serve as a day-to-day social media lead, participating in client meetings and presenting strategic recommendations and performance insights.

* Support community management and proactive engagement strategies that help brands participate in relevant conversations and strengthen audience relationships.
* Monitor platform trends, audience behavior, and emerging opportunities to inform content and channel recommendations.

**Measurement + Optimization**

* Establish and track social media KPIs using tools such as Sprout Social, Sprinklr, and native platform analytics.
* Analyze content and channel performance, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations.

**Integrated Campaigns + Influencer Collaboration**

* Experience managing multiple social media programs, including content planning, channel management, reporting, and client communication.
* Strong understanding of major social platforms and how to adapt content and strategy for different audiences.
* Experience developing executive thought leadership content and managing executive social profiles.
* Ability to guide creative development and provide thoughtful feedback on social copy, graphics, and video.
* Proficiency with social media management, analytics, and listening tools such as Sprout Social or Sprinklr.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate performance data into meaningful recommendations.
* Excellent writing, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
* A proactive, collaborative mindset and genuine curiosity about emerging social media trends, content formats, and audience behaviors.

**What We Offer (Compensation + Benefits):**

**Starting Salary: $50,000 - $55,100**

**Build content that connects with our customers**

Amador Jewelers is looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager to organize our day-to-day marketing work, create engaging content, and help develop our Marketing Associate. You will report to our Director of Marketing and work with company leadership to turn ideas into coordinated campaigns, videos, and social media content.

This role combines creative production with daily team coordination. You should be comfortable editing a long-form video, reviewing a content calendar, coaching a teammate, and explaining what the data suggests we should try next. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of assigned projects, communicate early, and keep work moving.

**What you will do**

* **Own the daily workflow.** Translate marketing priorities into clear tasks, timelines, and deliverables. Maintain campaign and production calendars, identify dependencies, and raise scheduling conflicts before deadlines are affected.
* **Coordinate production.** Prepare creative briefs, storyboards, and shoot plans. Coordinate participants, materials, and filming schedules across departments. Support video shoots and live productions.
* **Create and edit content.** Take the lead on long-form editing for YouTube, interviews, and podcasts. Support short-form videos and develop graphics, thumbnails, and campaign materials.
* **Manage the content pipeline.** Oversee the Marketing Associate’s scheduling work and maintain accurate content records, including versions, transcripts, approval status, and publishing destinations.

* **Oversee social media execution.** Verify that scheduled content publishes correctly across assigned channels, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Address publishing issues and coordinate follow-up.
* **Turn insights into action.** Review content performance, audience retention, engagement, and campaign findings. Recommend specific creative changes and tests based on what you observe.
* **Support paid campaigns.** Work with the Director of Marketing on ad creative, campaign reviews, and testing, within approved budgets and authorization.
* **Coach and communicate.** Guide the Marketing Associate, provide practical feedback, and participate in daily team check-ins. Share concise updates on completed work, open items, blockers, and next steps.

**What you bring**

* Demonstrated experience executing and coordinating content marketing across multiple social media platforms.
* A portfolio showing short-form and long-form video editing, graphic design, and content adapted for different channels and audiences.
* The ability to organize production schedules, manage several deliverables, and follow through without constant task-by-task direction.
* Experience guiding a teammate or coordinating the work of other contributors, with a practical and supportive approach to feedback.
* The ability to interpret content metrics and explain actionable recommendations in straightforward terms.
* An understanding of Hispanic audiences in the United States and an interest in learning about Amador’s customers.
* Familiarity with AI tools that support content creation and workflow, along with the judgment to review accuracy and quality before using their output.
* Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to take ownership of both creative work and operational follow-through.

**Experience we would value**

* Meta Ads, paid social creative testing, or campaign performance reviews.
* Live production, livestream support, or podcast production.
* Project management, website content updates, or content management systems.
* Jewelry, retail, wholesale, or other customer-facing businesses.

**How you will work**

You will work on-site in Lafayette, Indiana, alongside our Marketing Associate, with direction and ongoing feedback from our Director of Marketing. The planned daily schedule is 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., including a one-hour lunch. Weekly workdays will be discussed during the interview process.

You will have regular check-ins and reviews at 30, 60, and 90 days. Early expectations will focus on learning our brand and processes, keeping calendars and reports accurate, delivering assigned work, and communicating obstacles. As you become established, we will define production and performance goals together.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a portfolio link. Include examples of both short-form and long-form video, along with graphic design or campaign work. For each example, briefly explain your role in creating it. In your application, please share one example of a project you managed from planning through publication, and confirm your availability to work on-site in Lafayette, Indiana.

**About Sunnyside Nursing Post-Acute Care**

Centrally located in Torrance, California, Sunnyside Nursing and Post-Acute Care provides sub-acute nursing care, rehabilitation services, skilled nursing, and long-term care. Our compassionate staff offers individualized care plans for each resident to ensure personalized care is provided to all our patients with a goal to return home.

Our team of qualified professionals provides compassionate care by:

* Maintaining high medical integrity
* Fostering a team spirit among staff
* Creating friendly, beautiful surroundings for our residents and their visitors

We understand the importance of creating a comfortable and nurturing atmosphere, whether residents stay for short-term treatment or long-term care.

**Job Description**

The **Wound Program Coordinator** manages the facility wound care program including standards of care and practice related to wound, ostomy, and continence patient care needs.

Essential Functions:

* Develops and implements the facility wound care program in conjunction with the national standardization process, to include patient care protocols, documentation tools, and wound care formulary.
* Establishes standards of care, competencies, policies and procedures in quality, cost efficient and effective wound care for all clinical staff.
* Evaluates all wounds upon admission and ongoing to determine treatment plan and provide early problem identification.
* Provides consultation and/or assessment on patients with pressure ulcers. Consults on any wound that does not show measurable signs of healing within two weeks.
* In consultation with the physician, assists staff in developing an appropriate plan of care for comprehensive wound management.
* Makes recommendations to the physician for changes to wound care orders and provides evidence based research support as needed.
* Reviews charts of patients with wounds. Ensures that wound assessments, care plans, and treatments are clearly and correctly documented and that appropriate wound related treatments are being provided. Investigates all cases with adverse events related to wounds.
* Participates in clinical outcome monitoring, follow-up and agency performance improvement initiatives.
* Serves as a consultant to facility staff through training and support, enables clinical staff to effectively assess wounds, recommend appropriate protocols, and initiate plans of care.
* Manages Wound Treatment Team to ensure there is adequate coverage and employees are performing tasks based on expected standard
* Collaborates with Central Supply staff to maintain a cost-effective wound care formulary.
* Evaluates products and cost effectiveness and makes recommendation.
* Reviews and develops with all involved disciplines plan for discharge.
* Evaluates culture results and conference with physicians on Plan of Care.
* Involved in marketing the wound care program through outcomes and relationships with physicians.

**Licenses/Certification:**

* Current state LVN or RN license.
* Professional certification WOCN or CWS, or obtain certification within 12 months of employment.

**Experience:**

* Five (5) years licensed professional nursing experience performing wound care in a SNF, acute, or subacute setting.

  
**Requirements**

Must have a current and active California LVN or RN License

Must be authorized to work in the United States

Full-Time

Monday - Friday

8:30am - 5:00pm

My be required to work some weekends

  
  
**Benefits**

* Opportunities for growth
* Paid sick leave/paid holidays
* Medical, dental, vision, and Supplemental Insurance

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized **Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)** to join our growing clinical research team. In this role, you will coordinate and oversee the day-to-day operations of clinical trials, ensuring studies are conducted in compliance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), sponsor requirements, and regulatory guidelines.

You will work closely with Principal Investigators, sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and clinical staff to ensure the successful execution of research studies while maintaining the highest standards of participant safety and data integrity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Study Coordination**

* Coordinate and execute clinical trial visits according to study protocols and timelines.
* Screen, recruit, consent, and enroll eligible study participants.
* Perform study-related procedures as delegated by the Principal Investigator.
* Collect, document, and maintain accurate source documentation and study data.
* Enter study data into electronic data capture (EDC) systems in a timely manner.
* Maintain study binders, regulatory files, and essential study documentation.

**Regulatory & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, IRB requirements, sponsor SOPs, and site policies.
* Prepare and submit IRB applications, amendments, continuing reviews, and reportable events.
* Maintain complete and audit-ready regulatory documentation throughout each study.

**Sponsor & Monitor Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for sponsors, CROs, and study monitors.
* Coordinate and support site initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits.
* Respond to monitoring findings and complete follow-up action items.

**Participant Management**

* Educate participants on study procedures and expectations.
* Schedule participant visits and coordinate follow-up appointments.
* Ensure participant confidentiality, safety, and protocol compliance throughout the study.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Nursing, or a related field (or equivalent clinical research experience).
* 1–2 years of clinical research experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and FDA regulations.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple studies and deadlines simultaneously.

**Preferred**

* Experience using Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.
* Experience with eRegulatory platforms.
* Experience working in multi-site or high-volume clinical research settings.
* Phlebotomy, ECG, or other relevant clinical certifications.

If you are passionate about clinical research and committed to maintaining the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance, we encourage you to apply.

Pay: $28.00 - $33.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

This role is for someone who thrives on running several things at once. On any given week, you might be finalizing a private dinner guest list, designing signage for next month’s summit, and spinning up a virtual event around breaking news, all while keeping the events inbox under control.

new_jobs.description:
**Content Production Coordinator**

**About Cypherpunk**

At Cypherpunk Technologies (Cypherpunk), our mission is to advance technologies that guarantee privacy for humans on the internet. As a privacy technology company, Cypherpunk pursues this mission through three primary strategies: mining Zcash through Cypherpunk Mining; accumulating Zcash through open market purchases; and investing in, acquiring, and building technologies that push the frontier of privacy forward.

We are a small, ambitious team focused on building the future of privacy. We believe meaningful progress comes from people who are passionate about the mission, willing to challenge assumptions, and ready to adapt as technology and the industry evolve.

We value individuals who take ownership, move quickly, and turn ideas into results. Collaboration is central to how we operate, and every team member has a direct impact on our success. We encourage thoughtful debate, value different perspectives, and believe the best work happens when talented people genuinely enjoy working together.

We're building something important, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what comes next. If you're excited by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving industry, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the role**

Privacy is one of the defining fights of the internet, and most people have never heard the case for it told well. That’s where you come in. As Content Production Coordinator, you’ll run the engine behind Cypherpunk’s long-form content: the videos, podcasts, interviews, and deep dives that explain what we’re building and why it matters. You’ll take every piece from idea to publish, then turn it into clips, threads, and posts built for each platform’s algorithm, so the right people find it and stick around.

You’re terminally online, you know what makes a post hit vs. flop, and you can tell a trend is played out before everyone else does. You’ll back up your instincts with the numbers and make every post hit harder than the last. You’ll own this from day one. Your work will shape how Cypherpunk sounds, looks, and shows up online, for everyone from crypto natives to people thinking about privacy for the first time.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate long-form content from idea to publish: scheduling recordings, prepping guests and hosts, tracking edits, and keeping the content calendar on time
* Cut long-form pieces into clips, threads, and posts tailored to each platform (X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and whatever’s next)
* Write titles, thumbnail briefs, hooks, captions, and descriptions built to perform
* Track what’s working using platform analytics (watch time, retention, CTR, engagement) and use it to shape what we make next
* Keep a pulse on trends, formats, and conversations in crypto, privacy, and tech culture, and bring ideas to the team
* Manage assets, file organization, and publishing workflows so nothing slips
* Work with freelancers (editors, designers) on deliverables and timelines

**What we’re looking for**

* Experience in content, social media, or media production. A channel you’ve grown or work for a creator or brand counts as much as a job title
* Chronically online: you know the platforms, the formats, the memes, and the culture, and you can tell what will land with an audience
* A working understanding of how social media algorithms surface content, and how hooks, retention, posting cadence, and packaging affect reach
* A real appreciation for long-form content (YouTube, podcasts, deep-dive videos) and how to build an audience around it
* Strong organization and follow-through: you can juggle many moving pieces and hit deadlines
* Clear, sharp writing with a feel for voice and tone
* Curiosity about privacy, crypto, and the people building in these spaces (no technical background required)

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on video editing experience (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Descript)
* Experience with thumbnail design or tools like Figma or Canva
* A portfolio, channel, or account you’ve grown, with examples of content that performed
* Familiarity with crypto Twitter, the Zcash community, or privacy and cypherpunk culture
* Experience with podcast production or live streams

Compensation Range: $75K - $125K

### **Description**

The Client Services Helpdesk professional serves as a frontline resource for users who need prompt, courteous, and effective technical support. In this role, you will respond to requests for assistance in person, by phone, and through support channels, while troubleshooting hardware, software, and basic system issues. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with sound technical judgment, maintains accurate documentation, and delivers reliable support that helps end users remain productive. This position also plays an important role in escalating complex issues appropriately, following standard operating procedures, and contributing to a positive client support experience.  
  
This is an onsite role in Manhattan, NY.

The ideal candidate will bring 2–5 years of experience in a helpdesk, desktop support, or technical support environment, with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot common hardware, software, and user-access issues effectively. This individual should be comfortable working directly with end users, managing multiple requests, and maintaining a service-oriented approach in a fast-paced setting. Basic industry certifications are a plus and may include credentials such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft fundamentals, or similar entry-level technical certifications.

On a typical day, this role involves monitoring incoming support requests and assisting users with a wide range of technical needs. You will communicate with end users to gather relevant details, troubleshoot problems methodically, document actions taken, and ensure each issue is followed through to completion or properly escalated. Success in this role requires balancing responsiveness with accuracy, maintaining a professional and helpful demeanor, and contributing to a dependable support experience that reflects the standards of the Client Services team.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as the first point of contact for end users and client IT staff seeking technical assistance.
* Respond to inbound incidents and service requests through phone, email, ticketing systems, and in-person support.
* Troubleshoot and resolve basic to intermediate hardware, software, connectivity, and account access issues in a timely manner.
* Maintain end-to-end ownership of support requests, ensuring timely follow-up, clear communication, and appropriate resolution.
* Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and user interactions accurately within the designated support system.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to the appropriate support teams in accordance with established procedures.
* Provide users with clear, easy-to-understand guidance and updates throughout the support process.
* Assist with setup, configuration, and basic maintenance of workstations, peripherals, and standard business applications.
* Monitor support queues and address tickets based on SOP.
* Participate in and adhere to all standard operating procedures, service standards, and departmental policies.
* Identify recurring issues and share feedback or improvement opportunities with the broader support team.
* Support a professional, service-oriented environment by demonstrating patience, accountability, and responsiveness in all client interactions.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Strong customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to diagnose and resolve common technical issues efficiently and accurately.
* Working knowledge of desktop operating systems, business applications, printers, mobile devices, and basic networking concepts.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting incidents and resolutions.
* Ability to prioritize multiple requests and work effectively in a fast-paced support environment.
* Commitment to following procedures, maintaining professionalism, and delivering a high-quality support experience.

  

### **About Liss Technologies**

LISS Technologies provides the expert IT support your business needs to solve the technology challenges of today and provide a clear roadmap for the future.

Your business is like no other. As your trusted IT provider, we function as an extension of your business by taking your goals and culture into account and working tirelessly to provide the technology you need to get the job done. The basis of a true IT partnership is trust. Trust that we have the knowledge and experience to guide your technology decisions. Trust in our processes to be refined and customized to your needs. And, most importantly, trust that we always have your goals and interests in mind.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Catsy is a combined PIM (product information management) and DAM (digital asset management) platform. Industrial manufacturers, wholesale distributors and B2B brands use it to keep product data and images accurate and to publish them to their websites, catalogs and retail partners. Our AI-native tools, including an MCP integration with Claude, help customers do in minutes what used to take their teams weeks.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager, you own a book of Catsy customers from signed contract to renewal. You'll make sure each one goes live on time, gets real value from Catsy, and renews and grows with us.

You'll be the customer's main point of contact. You'll learn their catalog, their channels and their goals, then work with our sales, product and support teams to get them what they need. You'll use account data to spot risk early and find the next step that helps each customer most.

What you'll do

* **Own customer relationships.** Be the main point of contact for your accounts. Learn each customer's goals, workflows and concerns, and build trust with both day-to-day users and executives.
* **Lead onboarding and go-live.** Run kickoff, set the plan and dates, and coordinate data imports, channel setup and training so customers launch on schedule.
* **Drive adoption and value.** Check in regularly, run business reviews, and show customers how to get more from Catsy, such as faster product launches, cleaner data and new channels.
* **Manage renewals and growth.** Own renewal timing and spot expansion opportunities, such as more users, SKUs, channels or modules. Bring sales in when an upsell is ready.
* **Coordinate across teams.** Work with sales, product, support and client services to resolve issues, follow requests through to completion, and pass customer feedback to the product team.
* **Keep accounts organized.** Track activity, orders, account updates and follow-ups in Salesforce and other CRM tools, so anyone on the team can see where an account stands.
* **Use data to act early.** Review usage, support tickets and feedback to find at-risk accounts and growth opportunities, then act on what you find.

What you'll bring

* 3+ years in customer success, account management or client services, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
* Experience owning a book of accounts through onboarding, adoption and renewal.
* Clear writing and speaking, with customers and internal teams alike. You can explain technical topics in plain language.
* Strong organization and project management. You can run several onboardings at once without dropping details.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM, plus Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
* Comfort with account data. You can read usage trends and use them to decide what to do next.
* A problem-solving mindset and real care for how customers' businesses do.

Nice to have

* Experience with PIM, DAM, ecommerce or product data tools.
* Familiarity with manufacturing, wholesale distribution or B2B retail.
* Knowledge of sales channels such as Shopify, BigCommerce, Amazon or retailer portals.
* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or another customer success platform.
* Interest in AI tools and how they change everyday work.

How we'll measure success

* Customers go live on the date agreed at kickoff.
* Gross and net revenue retention across your book of accounts.
* Product adoption, including active users, SKUs managed and channels connected.
* Customer satisfaction, through CSAT or NPS.
* Expansion revenue you identify and pass to sales.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brooklyn, NY 11201

Compliance is the wedge. What we’re building is the whole trust layer with continuous, AI-driven code security, cloud security, device security - owned end to end instead of stitched together between vendors. We're not looking for someone learning to do this job. We're looking for someone who's already good at it and wants a bigger seat, faster growth, more financial upside, and more ownership than their current team can offer.

* Have real input into the outbound playbook as we refine, together, what actually works in this market.

-----------------------------------------------------

The infrastructure managing $300 trillion in assets was built in the 90's. Now, all of it is up for grabs. The winner of the AI era of investment management will be a $100B+ company. We intend to be that company.

To get there, we're assembling the most talent‑dense startup in New York. We hire people who are 1) exceptional, 2) allergic to anything that's not exceptional, and 3) recruiters of other exceptional people. We also have no tolerance for brilliant jerks.

We run lean by design. We work with a select group of the largest financial institutions in the world, go incredibly deep with each, and sit in the flow of trillions of dollars. We hire fewer people, ask each to own the outcome, and pay on impact ‑ not tenure or experience.

Moment is not for everyone. The standards are high. The pace is intense and there is no playbook.

In return: the best work of your career, building a generational company.

**About Moment**
----------------

Moment is the AI operating system for investment management, built for the world's largest wealth firms and fintechs. Moment works with firms managing more than $10 trillion in client assets and is backed by Index, a16z, and Lightspeed. Moment was founded by former quants from Citadel and Jane Street and is based in NYC.

**The Role**
------------

The team we build is the company we build, and bringing exceptional people into Moment is our top priority. Most of those people are not looking for a job. How our process runs and feels plays a real role in why they join.

Our standard is a great hotel. What you remember from a great hotel is that everything felt seamless, nothing fell through the cracks, and someone had thought about the small details that made you feel seen and cared for. We want candidates to feel the same way about interviewing with us.

Today that experience runs on a small team and a lot of hustle. We are hiring our first person dedicated to recruiting coordination and operations to help build the function from the ground up.

The job comes in three parts. You run our scheduling and logistics at a very high level. You automate and streamline as much of that as you can, without losing what makes the process feel human. You put the time that frees up into the strategic, tastemaking work behind the hospitality experience we give candidates and interviewers.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Coordinate the process**
--------------------------

Everything about the interviews should feel fast and effortless for candidates and interviewers, even when plans change.

* Learn our interview process for each role end to end, well enough to spot when something is off, fix what is yours to fix, and raise the rest early.
* Own scheduling, travel, and logistics end to end, from first calls to full onsite days, across busy calendars.
* Handle last-minute changes calmly, so it does not become a bad experience for the candidate.
* Keep Ashby accurate, so every candidate has a next step and an owner.

**Own the experience**
----------------------

You are the host from the first email on, well before anyone walks into the office.

* Keep every email and message warm, human, clear, and fast, so candidates always know what is happening next.
* Look for the small things at every stage that make someone feel expected, and make them happen. For example, put "in person" or "virtual" in the invite title so they can tell at a glance, send a packet before the onsite with the backgrounds of everyone they will meet, or find out what they like to eat and have lunch ordered before they arrive.
* Go into each onsite knowing who the candidate is, and own their day from the moment they arrive, including when something ends early or runs long.
* Treat interviewers as customers too. Make it easy for them to show up prepared and to give feedback, and take the logistics off their plate.

**Make it scale**
-----------------

The process should get better and more efficient each quarter, without losing the human touch.

* Find the slow, repetitive, or awkward parts of the process and fix them on your own initiative, using AI, Ashby automations, and whatever else works.
* Help us codify what great looks like for each part of the process, and build it into our systems and templates so it happens every time, even through hyper-growth.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

We care much more about how you operate than about years of experience or specific background. People who do well in this role may have come from recruiting coordination, executive support, office management, customer support, or operations roles. What they have in common:

* **You get the small things right, and people can rely on you.** When you say something will happen, it happens, and no one has to check.
* **You take pride in your work, even the unglamorous parts.** A lot of the work is scheduling and logistics, and you rightfully take pride in treating it as a craft and doing it at an extremely high level.
* **You use good judgment.** Given a goal and partial information, you figure out the rest and make sensible calls.
* **Delighting people is its own reward for you.** You have been this way your whole life, and the people around you would say so.
* **You write well.** Clearly and quickly, in a voice people enjoy hearing from.
* **You look for a better way.** You use AI every day, learn new tools fast, and would rather build something than repeat a task by hand.
* **You are curious about talent.** You want to learn how great teams get built and how to do talent at a world-class level.

**Why join Moment**
-------------------

* **Talent is the top priority here, and we operate that way.** Many companies say it. You will personally see it in your first week.
* **You will own and improve a candidate experience that is working.** Candidates already tell us our process stand

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant (Associate), OCEO
new_jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant (Associate), OCEO**

*Acumen is seeking an Executive Assistant to provide exceptionally reliable, detail-oriented support to the CEO and the Office of the CEO (OCEO). This is more than an administrative role: it calls for strong judgment, discretion, and anticipation. Reliability and clear communication are central to the role. Acumen's New York office operates on a hybrid schedule, with in-office work Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.*

  

**About Acumen**

Acumen is a global force of entrepreneurs, investors, philanthropists, and social innovators working together to build a world based on dignity. We were founded by Jacqueline Novogratz on the radical idea that business, when cultivated with moral imagination, can break the cycle of poverty. We invest in transformational companies, sustainable markets, and prepare leaders with the tools they need to create a more just and inclusive future. Since 2001, we have scaled companies and shaped markets in some of the hardest-to-reach communities on the planet, impacting over half-a-billion lives. To learn more visit acumen.org.

  

**About the Office of the CEO**

The Office of the CEO (OCEO) enables Jacqueline Novogratz to engage effectively across Acumen and with external stakeholders. The team works in close partnership across executive strategy, engagement, operations, and administrative execution, with clear decision rights and shared visibility.

  

**About the Role**

The Executive Assistant carries out logistics, travel, and administrative support for Jacqueline Novogratz, who travels roughly 60 to 70 percent of the year. The role also provides in-person support in the New York office. It reports to the Manager, Executive Operations, who is the focal point for scheduling, and works closely with the Chief of Staff.

  

**Accountabilities Include:**

  

***Logistics and in-person support***

* Executes day-to-day scheduling across time zones at the Manager's direction, and supports scheduling for the Chief of Staff as needed
* Supports high-volume communications and inbox management with discernment, helping prioritize, draft, and respond, and escalating to the Manager when needed
* Provides in-person support when Jacqueline is in the New York office, keeping her day on track, ensuring smooth transitions between meetings, and preparing her briefing binder
* Coordinates logistics for dinners, salons, and other events in partnership with the Manager
* Supports coordination with external organizations and initiatives Jacqueline is engaged with, as directed by the Manager

  

***Travel***

* Books Jacqueline's travel once the Manager has confirmed trip details, researching options, handling routine changes, applying her preferences, and flagging constraints early
* Prepares travel packs with itineraries, meeting schedules, clearance materials, and relevant background, and secures visas, passport pages, and other documents well ahead of international trips
* Handles travel logistics for board trips in partnership with the Manager and the Chief of Staff

  

***Relationship support and correspondence***

* Supports the Manager on the outreach cadence and quarterly correspondence review, tracking follow-up and preparing inputs ahead of each review
* Supports the Manager on inbound and outbound correspondence through the CEO's inbox
* Drafts follow-up correspondence in partnership with the Chief of Staff

  

***Research and media monitoring***

* Monitors the press and news on key contacts, flagging relevant coverage and escalating material developments to the OCEO team
* Conducts relationship-tracking research ahead of board trips and key meetings, and provides memo and research support
* Takes on additional assignments as needed, including operational support

  

***Expenses, invoices, timesheets, and documents***

* Prepares and tracks expense reports and processes invoices and expenses in accordance with Acumen's Travel & Expense Policy
* Reviews and advises on expense reports for the CEO and her direct reports.
* Manages the CEO's timesheets
* Coordinates with Talent, Legal, and Finance on contracts, signatures, approvals, and related documentation, and tracks signatures and information for CEO-related documents through to delivery

  

***Briefings, meetings, and projects***

* Helps prepare briefings and talking points
* Schedules and supports logistics for the standing meeting with Development & Partnerships and the regional focal points
* Supports the Chief of Staff and the Manager on special projects as needed

  

**How the Role Operates**

  

**Reliability, accuracy, and clear communication are core expectations of this role, not extras.**

* Proactive communication. Keeps the Manager continuously informed, and the Chief of Staff when working with her directly. Surfaces changes, conflicts, risks, and open questions early, without waiting to be asked.
* Responsiveness. Responds in a timely, consistent, and reliable manner, especially when working remotely. Is a clear communicator who makes it easy to see what is needed and by when.
* A consistent rhythm. Joins the weekly team sync with the Chief of Staff and the Manager, and the Monday look-ahead, so support is integrated rather than siloed.
* Attention to detail. Delivers expense reports, timesheets, documents, and correspondence that are accurate, complete, and ready without rework, in line with Acumen policies.
* Consistency. Delivers the same high standard every week, not just during busy periods, so the Manager and the Chief of Staff can rely on the work without checking it.
* Follow-through. Closes the loop on every request, tracks signatures and approvals through to completion, and flags anything delayed or unresolved before it becomes a problem.
* Sound judgment. Knows what needs escalation and brings it to the Manager early, with a recommendation where possible. Stays calm when plans change.
* Discretion. Handles confidential and sensitive info

ChainIT Inc. builds verification-first infrastructure for identity, agreements, payments and assets. Our philosophy is simple: nothing is assumed, and everything is verified. Every party is verified before value or data moves, and every transaction and every agent action leaves an immutable, append-only record. We hold 15 U.S. patents.

One platform connects our products. ChainIT ID verifies each party, Pactvera binds the terms, ChainIT Pay moves the value and Valitorum proves it.

**The role**

The BDR & Sales Coordinator builds pipeline across ChainIT's product lines and keeps the commercial engine running. You'll research prospects and reach out to them, qualify leads and book meetings. Then you'll keep every opportunity moving through the CRM, the calendar and the follow-up. You'll report directly to ChainIT's Chief Commercial Officer (CCO), which gives you a front-row view of executive leadership, commercial strategy and client relationships.

* Research the market. Find target accounts and the right contacts, and build prospect lists for ChainIT's products.

* Qualify inbound and outbound leads, and book discovery meetings for the CCO and the commercial team.

We care most about finding people who fit our team and share our drive to learn and grow. Whether you have many years of experience or none, if this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply.

*Required*

* You're curious about building a career in sales and business development. You don't need prior sales experience.
* You enjoy learning, welcome feedback and like seeing yourself improve over time.
* You prefer solving problems together to assigning blame, which matters at a growing company like ours.
* You're comfortable picking up new systems and tools, and you take the initiative with training and your own development.

*What sets you apart*

ChainIT pays for your medical, dental and vision coverage, so there's no employee premium for your own coverage. You also get paid time off.

This role is a great fit if you're excited to launch a sales career, learn directly from ChainIT's Chief Commercial Officer and pick up the phone to start real conversations. You'll thrive here if you enjoy figuring things out as you go in a fast-growing environment, and if you want to learn how we're building verification-first identity and payments for the agentic era.

**Overview**

The In-Home Flooring Sales Representative is responsible for meeting with prospective customers in their homes, assessing their flooring and remodeling needs, presenting product options, preparing estimates, and closing sales.

This is a consultative sales position that requires strong communication, relationship-building, and closing skills. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, managing a sales pipeline, and guiding customers through the purchasing process while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

The representative will work directly with homeowners to recommend flooring solutions that align with their style preferences, functional needs, and budgets.

**Key Duties**

**In-Home Sales & Customer Consultations**

* Conduct scheduled in-home appointments with prospective customers.
* Evaluate existing flooring conditions and discuss customer renovation goals.
* Identify customer needs, preferences, project timelines, and budgets.
* Present flooring products, materials, colors, styles, and installation options.
* Provide knowledgeable recommendations based on product durability, maintenance, aesthetics, and overall value.
* Build trust and establish strong relationships with homeowners.

**Sales & Business Development**

* Generate sales by effectively presenting products, services, and project solutions.
* Prepare accurate estimates, proposals, and pricing options.
* Negotiate pricing and confidently overcome customer objections.
* Convert qualified leads into signed contracts and completed sales.
* Consistently achieve or exceed monthly sales and revenue targets.

* Maintain an organized sales pipeline and accurately document customer interactions.

**Project Coordination & Customer Experience**

* Coordinate with the operations and installation teams to ensure accurate project details.
* Communicate customer expectations, product selections, measurements, and project specifications.
* Maintain communication with customers throughout the sales and installation process.
* Address customer questions and concerns professionally.
* Ensure a smooth transition from the sales process to project completion.
* Deliver an exceptional customer experience that encourages referrals and repeat business.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Previous sales experience preferred, particularly in flooring, home improvement, remodeling, construction, or residential services.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build rapport and close sales.
* Customer-focused mindset with a consultative sales approach.
* Strong negotiation and objection-handling abilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple customer opportunities.
* Comfortable conducting in-home appointments and presenting products.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with CRM systems.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings and weekends.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience selling flooring products such as hardwood, laminate, tile, and carpet.
* Knowledge of flooring installation processes, measurements, and material estimates.
* Experience selling remodeling or home improvement projects.
* Familiarity with estimating software, CRM platforms, and sales tracking tools.
* Existing relationships within the residential construction or home improvement industry.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Self-motivated:** Takes ownership of their sales pipeline and consistently pursues opportunities.
* **Results-driven:** Focuses on closing deals and achieving sales goals.
* **Personable:** Builds trust and establishes meaningful relationships with homeowners.
* **Persuasive:** Can effectively communicate value and overcome objections without being overly aggressive.
* **Detail-oriented:** Ensures estimates, measurements, product selections, and project details are accurate.

new_jobs.description:
**About CodeHS**
----------------

CodeHS is a comprehensive platform helping K-12 schools teach computer science. We provide curriculum, professional development, and a full software platform. CodeHS is used by millions of students and thousands of schools and districts around the US and the world.

**Mission**
-----------

**The mission of CodeHS is to empower all students to meaningfully impact the future.** We believe that in the 21st century, coding is a foundational skill, just like reading and writing. That’s why we say: **Read, Write, Code.** Coding and computer science are essential skills for students to learn and schools to teach.

**About the role**

CodeHS is looking for an Account Manager to help manage and renew customer accounts.

You will get a chance to work closely with educators and schools to facilitate teaching coding to students all over the world.

**Location: This role is a 5 days a week office role in the CodeHS Chicago Office in River North.**

**What you'll do**

* The primary responsibility is to renew customer accounts
* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts
* Handle upsells and additional orders and expansions for existing customers
* Work with teachers and administrators on CodeHS implementation
* Have a deep understanding of the CodeHS product
* Closely track and manage account data
* Keep and maintain data in a CRM for renewals reporting and projections
* Meet with school and district administrators on account check ins
* Work with school administrators and other stakeholders to improve computer science programs
* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers on account implementation

**Qualifications**

* Passionate about improving access to quality education
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Extremely organized and detail oriented
* Interest in personally learning more about coding, prior experience a plus
* 2 years sales experience
* Account Management or Edtech sales or account management experience preferred
* 5-10% travel, company/department meet ups are approximately quarterly and there may be conference or customer travel

You're a great fit for this position if you are passionate about improving education, building strong relationships, going the extra mile to solve problems creatively, and working on the forefront to use technology to improve education.

**Location**  
  

* Full Office - This role is a 5 days a week office role in the CodeHS Chicago Office in River North.

**Compensation**  
Total Compensation including Base Salary and Commissions:

$85,000 - $115,000

### **Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with 4% match
* Paid parental leave
* Strong vacation policy (22 days off + 16 company holidays)
* Short-term and long-term disability
* CTA monthly pass covered
* Lunch provided 3 days per week

**Company Values**
------------------

#### **Encourage Teaching and Learning**

CodeHS is about providing excellent teaching and learning opportunities in computer science for students all over the world. We value creating fun, accessible and creative learning experiences for teachers, for students, and for team members at CodeHS. We believe that education-and specifically coding-within the formal K-12 system, the higher-education system, and beyond has the power to allow everyone to unlock their full potential.

#### **Create a Direct Positive Impact**

At CodeHS we value creating a direct positive social impact with our work. We work directly with students, teachers, schools and districts to implement computer science classes. Through building great curriculum, tools and resources to allow high schools to teach computer science, we can create a direct educational benefit to students to help explore the limitless world of computing. We believe that expanding access to computer science education will empower students to take an active role in creating the future.

#### **Make It Fun and Creative**

Bringing fun and creativity to every aspect of our work is a main focus for us at CodeHS. It starts with a fun, friendly and accessible curriculum, that allows students the opportunity to build creatively and engage in thoughtful problem solving. We also focus on developing a creative and fun environment to work in, and think that this allows us to bring novel approaches to challenging problems. Computing is about logic-but it’s also about creativity-and we hope to share that excitement with teachers and students through CodeHS.

**Our Operating Practices**

**Get the job done**

We figure out the real problem to be solved and take ownership over seeing it to completion. We help move things across the finish line.

**Bring context and big picture awareness**

We consider the projects we work on in their context and see how our projects impact the team, company, and the customer.

**Adaptable**

We adapt to changing needs across customers and the team, and make good plans but know that they can change as we get new information.

**Growth Mindset**

We're always looking to learn and improve, and we share that mindset with teachers and students. We’re working to improve individually and as a team.

**Team player**

We help out our teammates and we’re team players. We make decisions with a team first approach and strive to act in the best interest of the company as a whole.

**Constructive and solution oriented**

When approached with problems and roadblocks, we're constructive and solution oriented. We think through problems and tradeoffs, proactively finding solutions.

**Good vibes**

We bring positive energy whether in person or virtually to help contribute to making a positive work environment for everyone.

**Follow through**

We make sure to do what we say we are going to do for team members and for customers. We're proactive, dependable and reliable in the work that we do.

The successful candidate combines strategic account management with aggressive business development to deliver sustainable revenue and profit growth. This high-visibility role will allow this candidate to become one of the key faces of our TASK Force implementing each of the core principles this national team sets out to redefine through Trials, Awareness, Solutions, & Knowledge.

**Key Job Responsibilities:**

* Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities with incremental contractors, trade organizations, and key institutions.
* Hunt for large-scale, strategic conversion opportunities through consultative sales process and in-field discovery
* Establish yourself as a product expert and sales strategist through collaboration with distribution partners to identify opportunities, execute strategic promotions or programs, and expand EGO Commercial’s market penetration
* Expand product assortment of current customers, thus driving stronger distribution support.
* Lead annual and multi-year growth strategies focused on market share gains and customer expansion.
* Deliver concise & impactful hands-on product demonstrations, technical training, and sales education to distributor teams and end users to strengthen product knowledge and position our solutions as the right choice
* Challenge the status quo and pursue opportunities beyond existing business relationships.
