new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Position:**Customer Success Manager

**Reports To****:**Director of Customer Success

**Location:**Chicago

**Job Overview**

The Customer Success Manager is responsible for helping customers obtain the most value from Reveal’s software platform. As a member of Reveal’s Customer Success team, you will build relationships, understand customer objectives and challenges, determine, and mitigate customer risk, and identify product adoption and upsell opportunities.

The ideal candidate has strong business acumen and empathy to place oneself in a “client’s shoes,” as well as demonstrated success within the eDiscovery or data forensics industries. Strong organization and time management skills are required to proactively manage and drive product adoption. Success criteria within the role will be tied to an ability to be a trusted client partner who can effectively identify and mitigate account risk and rally all levels of Reveal management to retain and ultimately increase our customers’ usage of all Reveal products.
  
  
In this role, you will work closely with a highly collaborative team and have access to many colleagues who can help ensure timely and effective responses to clients. We operate on a mostly in office schedule, with team members working onsite four days per week with work from home Fridays. This role requires a regular in-office presence to support collaboration, training, and client service. Our office is conveniently located in the heart of Chicago with easy access to major public transportation lines.

**Responsibilities & Duties**

* Work closely with clients to ensure successful onboarding onto the Reveal platform.
* Ability to multi-task and proactively manage the needs of multiple accounts.
* Communicate effectively with all levels of a customer’s management team, instilling a sense of confidence in Reveal’s ability to resolve application issues.
* Understand customer health and proactively mitigate renewal risk.
* Manage and drive customer escalations to completion.
* Hold Quarterly Business Reviews with customers to discuss the relationship and gauge satisfaction.
* Identify upsell opportunities to add revenue and employ strategies to drive additional product usage.
* Track and report usage metrics and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Provide feature walkthroughs for the latest product releases.
* Collaborate with internal teams to address customer challenges.
* Establish and provide eDiscovery strategies and best practices using the Reveal platform.
* Build and cultivate strong customer relationships.
* Serve as the voice of the customer internally to influence the product roadmap and to ensure features meet customer needs.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support team, department and organizational goals.

**Characteristics**

* Driven, collaborative individual who is a team player.
* Excellent organization and time management skills to handle multiple, competing demands.
* Ability to quickly learn and understand technology.
* Problem solver with strong attention to detail.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills to manage expectations

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelors’ in technology (computer science, IT, etc.) or legal field (Paralegal, JD).
* 3-5 years’ experience in account management or consulting within eDiscovery, data forensics, or legal industry.
* Reveal, Brainspace, ACEDS, or other eDiscovery certification(s).
* Proven track record in Sales, Customer Success, or Support in Legal and/or eDiscovery technology.
* Prior experience in collaborating with and building strong relationships with clients.
* Project Management experience and/or PMP certification preferred.

**Benefits and Perks including but not limited to:**

* 401k match program
* Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and HSA/FSA)
* Group Term Life Insurance and Voluntary Life Insurance option
* Paid holidays
* Paid vacation, sick, and personal days
* FSA dependent care benefit
* Childbirth recovery and bonding leave policies
* Short and long-term disability benefits
* Access to onsite gym and recreational area at our Chicago office
* Friendly, collaborative, in-office work environment with ample opportunity for professional development.

For Illinois-based roles, the budgeted annual salary range is $93,500 to $110,000 plus participation in one of our sales commission plans. Compensation for this role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. Reveal offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes the Benefits and Perks set forth above.

**About the Team**

Workday’s Specialized Customer Success team helps customers drive adoption and realize value from our emerging products. This team supports our newest offering—a leading agentic identity platform for people and agents—helping organizations govern workforce access, deploy AI agents, and modernize their identity and access programs.
  
We’re growing our Customer Success team across Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial segments. With fewer than 10 people today, this is a team where you can help shape how we work, develop our people, and build the processes that let us scale as the business grows.

So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you've found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Role**

As a Manager, Customer Success – Agentic Identity, you will lead a team of Customer Success Managers across Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial segments. You will be accountable for net dollar retention across the full customer portfolio, partnering closely with Sales to retain customers and identify opportunities for growth.

  

This role is as much about building the team as leading it. You will establish hiring, onboarding, and ramp processes, develop repeatable playbooks, and coach CSMs to deliver the right engagement for each customer segment. You will take people development as seriously as customer outcomes, helping your team grow while building a Customer Success function that can scale.

  

**In this role, you will be responsible for:**

**Own.** Lead a team of CSMs spanning Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial segments. Be accountable for net dollar retention across the whole portfolio, not just one segment’s numbers.

**Grow.** Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities. Coach your team to identify upsell and cross-sell signals early, and step in when an expansion conversation needs leadership involvement.

**Build.** Establish the hiring, onboarding, and ramp processes the team needs to scale. With fewer than 10 people on the team today, help build the foundation for continued growth while managing capacity and coverage.

**Improve.** Build playbooks, customer health scoring, and Quarterly and Executive Business Review cadences that work across segments, while allowing for the different needs of Strategic, Enterprise, and Commercial customers.

**Develop.** Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and manage performance for your direct reports. Identify opportunities for CSMs to take on greater responsibility and build development plans that help them get there.

**Drive Customer Outcomes:** Lead the team in accelerating platform adoption, measuring customer value, realization, and establishing repeatable success motions that connect customer outcome to retention, advocacy, and expansion.

**Lead cross functionally:** Partner with Sales, Deployment, Product, and the broader Workday Customer Success organization to align customer engagement , strengthen hand-offs, resolve systematic challenges, and deliver a connected customer experience

* 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related roles within B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* 3+ years of experience directly leading and developing a Customer Success or Account Management team.

**Other Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience owning and improving net dollar retention, beyond gross retention or customer satisfaction measures.
* Experience leading teams that support different customer segments, such as Strategic or Enterprise and Commercial or Mid-Market, with different account volumes, coverage models, and engagement cadences.

*Chicago, IL, Office - based*

From our headquarters in Amsterdam, we have built a global customer base. A few months ago we opened our first US office in Chicago, and the momentum is strong. Now we’re looking for ambitious people to help us scale even faster. This role is part of that foundation.

You will join our sales leader, who leads the Mid-Market Sales Team, and has been with Vesper since the beginning. Our Mid-Market Sales function is built locally in Amsterdam, with leadership and another SDR in Chicago who are scaling a new team. As the second Sales Development Representative, you will play a key role in Vesper’s success in the United States. It’s a perfect opportunity to build from the ground up within an already successful global company.

The timing couldn’t be better. For years, FMCG companies have been constrained by limited choice among legacy market intelligence solutions. Now, they are switching to Vesper faster each quarter.

We have all the tools, a healthy and happy U.S. customer base, and we will train you to succeed in this role and wherever you grow within Vesper. We have the product, infrastructure, and a happy, growing U.S. customer base in place. Plus, you’ll get to visit the beautiful canals in Amsterdam from time-to-time to meet your other colleagues in person.

#### **What you will be doing**

* **Build pipeline** for the U.S. sales team to convert into happy Vesper customers
* **Execute hyper-personalized outbound motions** including email, LinkedIn and cold calling to initiate high-value conversations with senior procurement leaders (cold calling is part of the job and a highly effective channel in our industry)
* **Shape the outbound strategy to fit the U.S. market well, building on Vesper’s successful outbound motion in other markets**

**Overview:**  
Performs a variety of clerical functions, which may often vary in type and sequence, to complete assignments related to the Breath Alcohol Ignition Interlock Device Program (BAIID) including, but not limited to, preparation and maintenance of division files and electronic database, basic correspondence, and serve as division receptionist.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Reviews offender’s applications for the Monitoring Device Driving Permit (MDDP) program for correctness and completeness; reviews offenders driving record and determines if all requirements are met for the program; determines fees, types and mails notice to the offender regarding eligibility requirements.
* Prepares routine outgoing mailings which may include informational material about the BAIID program; answers telephone and responds to routine questions from the general public pertaining to operations and procedures; directs the more technical and difficult questions to appropriate staff.
* Creates and maintains files for new and incoming offenders which include all required documents and information; ensures all requirements are met and payments received; validates payments; logs information into the BAIID Database for each client
* Processes daily mailings to offenders regarding violations utilizing a personal computer to prepare mailing labels, memoranda, etc.; may type routine correspondence to responds to inquiries dealing with program operations.
* Pulls files on an as needed basis for review and hearings; files when process is complete.

Requires knowledge, skill and mental development equivalent to completion of high school and six months of related office experience as would be gained as an Operations Clerk.

* Requires working knowledge of alphanumeric sequencing.

* Requires ability to operate commonly used office equipment and perform routine maintenance.
* Requires the ability to lift and carry up to 10 lbs.

**WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO**

Since 1994, The Family Business Consulting Group has worked with over 3,000 enterprising families in 70 countries to achieve one common goal: protect the integrity of the family and the enterprise for future generations. We share a core belief that multi-generational family enterprises are precious and vitally important to the economies and social fabric of the world and deserve the best care and counsel.

Located across North America, our team is the leading independent family enterprise consulting business, continuously strengthening our practice and our people to deliver the best care, counsel, and resources to valued client families. We facilitate clarity and balance between sensitive family issues and critical business decisions. FBCG consultants practice disciplines that include strategy, management, finance, governance, psychology, leadership development, communication, conflict resolution, succession planning, family education, and more. Our people-centered approach helps families work together more effectively to secure their legacy and continue to grow across generations.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Family Business Consulting Group is seeking a proactive, highly organized Executive Assistant to provide direct, high-level administrative support to our CEO—someone who brings sound judgment, takes initiative, and keeps key firm initiatives moving across the finish line. This is a key part-time role requiring roughly 10 to 15 hours per week. It is ideally suited for someone looking for a long-term part-time position with a consistent weekday schedule during core business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM). Each week, you will review open items and activities and lead a Friday planning meeting with the CEO to close open loops and prepare for the week ahead.

This is a remote-first position. During the first 60 days, onboarding and training will require working in our Rosemont office one day a week to collaborate hand in hand with the CEO. Following onboarding, in-person support will be needed periodically based on the CEO’s needs, as well as attending portions of our annual team meeting and quarterly offsite retreats in the Chicago area. * **Document & Presentation Preparation** - Format, proofread, and finalize pitch decks, executive memos, and firm-wide announcements from the CEO’s drafts.
* **Expense Management & Reporting** - Prepare, submit, and reconcile executive expense reports, credit card statements, and vendor invoices.
